Hello,
Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad.
For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before _Roe v. Wade_ ...
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85327409/474401509/1610638071?refcode=em20240520pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=1fe52e3e-0917-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZmU1MmUzZS0wOTE3LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AgzNWUWgkpIFU4bM1ziENBpmbSfzTkoAWeqhZm6hIBs=)
Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats.
Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue.
My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy.
**Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponents want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not.**
What’s extreme is pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages.
Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor.
I would have thought that after almost losing this seat last year, they might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But they've only doubled down on the extreme.
**Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024 by winning this seat and replacing her in Congress.**

subject: The Republican Party of Texas Can Adopt Term Limits and Closed Primaries Without Legislative Approval
body:
Texas voters have a problem: career politicians.
No images? [Click here](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-e-edilyul-yuddtktydi-n/) [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-edilyul-yuddtktydi-r/) **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Press Manager
Contact: [Press@HuffinesLiberty.com](mailto:Press@HuffinesLiberty.com)
## **The Republican Party of Texas Can Adopt Term Limits and Closed Primaries Without Legislative Approval**
[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-edilyul-yuddtktydi-y/) DALLAS, TX, May 20th, 2024 -- Today, the Huffines Liberty Foundation is releasing its latest report, [_The Republican Party of Texas Can Adopt Term Limits and Closed Primaries Without Legislative Approval_](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-edilyul-yuddtktydi-j/).Texas voters have a problem: career politicians. There are no state-imposed term limits for any office in Texas. The longer politicians stay in office, the more they cater to special interests and the less responsive they are to voters.Term limits have proven to be popular among voters as a way to reduce corruption and recapture some of the attention of politicians. For instance, term limits have been shown to be effective in reducing spending growth. Sixteen states now have term limits on state legislators, while 37 have some kind of limits on governors. Before being struck down by the U.S. Supreme Court, 23 states had imposed limits on congressional offices.Another way that voters in political parties have sought to refocus politicians on the priorities of their parties is through closed primaries. Nineteen states currently have some form of closed primary. The concept behind them is that if politicians are nominated only by members of the political party they are supposed to represent, they are more likely to adhere to party platforms and priorities.Term limits and closed primaries are both examples of political parties exercising their freedom of association under the First Amendment to the U.S. Constitution. Courts have consistently upheld this right of political parties, particularly when it comes to the process of parties selecting their nominees. Many Republicans in Texas have expressed interest in using both mechanisms to improve party candidate selection in future elections.Texas Republicans can't rely on career politicians to solve these problems for us. Career politicians want to keep their jobs without being accountable to the parties and voters. This history leaves no doubt; if Texans want to regain greater influence over their public servants by imposing term limits on them and selecting them through closed primaries, we cannot rely on politicians to make this happen.Fortunately, precedents in Texas, in other states, and in the U.S. Supreme Court provide a path for the Republican Party of Texas to take the extra-legislative step of adopting a closed primary and term limits through its own rules and implementing them in time for the next Republican primary in 2026. [Read Full Report](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-edilyul-yuddtktydi-t/) The Huffines Liberty Foundation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit, non-partisan research institute. Our mission is to advance the cause of **liberty** , **prosperity** , and **virtue** in the State of Texas by educating and equipping citizens so they may hold their elected officials accountable and better informed to tackle the toughest challenges.###

body:
There is a powerful movement in our culture to teach young Americans that

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zeaj6tq08dmold6r4nlsp5h4026tgp50e6c7b9do_rp22sh2s8i6ep33c9ge2pr6c5h2bs)
---
| | Fellow American, There is a powerful movement in our culture to teach young Americans that our nation’s history is **oppressive** and **shameful**. Sometimes, this effort goes under the name “critical race theory.” Other times, activists advance these ideas through works like _The_ _New York Times_ ’ __ “1619 Project.”

This radical movement pushes a narrative that slavery, not freedom, is the defining characteristic of American history. They teach our children that we should replace equal individual rights with the idea of unequal rights based on group identity.
---
| | **Hillsdale College is committed to countering this destructive ideology. That’s why we have produced a new, free online course titled[“Civil Rights in American History.”](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2za394eevcdfi1tj040c0q94a84nv570nurhesfto_rp22sh2s8i6ep33c9ge2pr6c5h2bs) And right now, it is available in a special, limited DVD box set.** When you take this course, you’ll learn about:
* How our Founding Founders understood equality, natural rights, and civil rights.
* The quest for justice in America through the Civil War, during Reconstruction, and in the 20th century.
* The danger posed to freedom and civil rights today by identity politics.

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Lessons in Statesmanship
body:
Perhaps no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny than Winston Churchill.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zet7mdckddk8vfiq4lbqt71haod3t59q7294eo9g_rp22sh2s8i6ep33c9geaor2c3h2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, Perhaps no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny than Winston Churchill. Not only did he diagnose the threat of modern technology, but he also spoke most effectively against the idea of socialism. So, it should come as no surprise to learn that so many “academics” and activists are working to smear Churchill’s legacy. That’s why studying an accurate account of his accomplishments is more important than ever. And right now, you can do just that when you get a copy of one of Hillsdale College’s most popular online courses, [**“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,”**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrqnsho2ko2gd0eovqsigbd6lm7b9m41r7ecuaqg_rp22sh2s8i6ep33c9geaor2c3h2bs) on DVD.
---
| | Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, **and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.** When you view this close study of Churchill’s words and deeds, you’ll learn timeless lessons that teach:
* The principles and virtues required for great statesmanship.
* How to deal with the threats and opportunities presented by modern technology.
* How to confront the threat of socialism.
* How to serve the cause of our own country as it appears today.

**I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set. And it can be yours today when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv85locts459v1g1td67vot0kdn9k6a9aa32d7c0_rp22sh2s8i6ep33c9geaor2c3h2bs)
---
| | You can reserve your copy using this secure link: _[**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk3ocvli2q5dqsb3s65keu92anvja9j8j2f923uo_rp22sh2s8i6ep33c9geaor2c3h2bs)_ As a student of Dr. Arnn myself, I know that his lectures on Churchill will teach you more about this subject than many other books and videos available today. And they will reveal profound lessons that apply to today’s urgent problems. Only a limited number of these DVD sets are available, so I hope you’ll take this opportunity to add it to your personal library or give it as a gift—before they’re gone. You can use this secure link to reserve your copy of **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship** ” on DVD right now: _[**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3aj69p6o2jqa5n4nqgch5tub2ap929r76ddufag_rp22sh2s8i6ep33c9geaor2c3h2bs)_ Please enjoy this essential study of Churchill’s words and deeds. | RIP: Our Friend Randy Reynolds, Sr.
---
|
---
| Friends,
It is with much sorrow, I inform you our dear friend Randy Reynolds Sr. has passed. We are praying for the family. In addition to much success in business, Randy lived an incredible life of helping and advising others including business owners, military members, inner city kids, politicians, world leaders, and more. I stopped by from time to time to check in with Randy, his son, and his grandson and talk politics, business, our military, and more. In his office there are photos of Randy and many prominent world leaders to include Ronald Reagan, Margaret Thatcher, Donald Trump, and more.
My team and I mentored several current members of our military including a few Navy SEALs on his farm where we swam across the lake, shot guns, did push ups, carried sand bags, and more. My wife Tracy and I were recently in his living talking with Randy, his sweet wife Susan, and their dog Ginger. Thank you Randy for your kindness, you will be missed.
A funeral service for Mr. Reynolds will take place on Wednesday, May 22nd at 11:00 a.m. at St. Mary's Episcopal Church located at 12291 River Road, Richmond, VA 23238.
In lieu of flowers, please consider a donation to either Companions for Heroes, 501 Gloucester St., Suite 102, Brunswick, GA 31520 on whose Board he served or The Elizabeth Dole Charitable Foundation, 700 New Hampshire Ave., NW, #112, Washington, D.C. 20037-2407.

clean_body: | | | | | | == | == | RIP: Our Friend Randy Reynolds, Sr. | | Friends, It is with much sorrow, I inform you our dear friend Randy Reynolds Sr. has passed. We are praying for the family. In addition to much success in business, Randy lived an incredible life of helping and advising others including business owners, military members, inner city kids, politicians, world leaders, and more. I stopped by from time to time to check in with Randy, his son, and his grandson and talk politics, business, our military, and more. In his office there are photos of Randy and many prominent world leaders to include Ronald Reagan, Margaret Thatcher, Donald Trump, and more. My team and I mentored several current members of our military including a few Navy SEALs on his farm where we swam across the lake, shot guns, did push ups, carried sand bags, and more. My wife Tracy and I were recently in his living talking with Randy, his sweet wife Susan, and their dog Ginger. Thank you Randy for your kindness, you will be missed. A funeral service for Mr. Reynolds will take place on Wednesday, May 22nd at 11:00 a.m. at St. Mary's Episcopal Church located at 12291 River Road, Richmond, VA 23238. In lieu of flowers, please consider a donation to either Companions for Heroes, 501 Gloucester St., Suite 102, Brunswick, GA 31520 on whose Board he served or The Elizabeth Dole Charitable Foundation, 700 New Hampshire Ave., NW, #112, Washington, D.C. 20037-2407. == | | | | For God and Country, Senator John McGuire Soli Deo Gloria Republican Jesus is my Savior Husband Father Navy SEAL == Pro-Life == Pro-Gun (==) Pro-Israel (==) American Legion Member VFW (Life Member) NRA (Life Member) Highest Award for Conservatism (ACU/ CPAC) Family Foundation 100 VCDL 100 (Life Member) == The Spirit of Virginia == our Facebook Page Twitter: @JohnMcGuire4VA Instagram: JohnMcGuire4VA == == john@mcguireva.com www.mcguireva.com | | | == | == | == | == == == | Paid for and Authorized by McGuire for Virginia | | McGuire for Virginia | PO Box 242, Manakin Sabot, VA 23103 | | Sent by mailto:john@mcguireva.com powered by

* How to deal with the threats and opportunities presented by modern technology.
* How to confront the threat of socialism.
* How to serve the cause of our own country as it appears today.

body:

Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/bB25PHw1U-3nDnA0QYVmZQ~~/AARclAA~)
---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---

Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/bB25PHw1U-3nDnA0QYVmZQ~~/AARclAA~)

body:
There is a powerful movement in our culture to teach young Americans that

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=70a38a34ca754f4584e2bfc8457b7c9a&_e=iEhU_leDXpWWxHxhy53TGUbb1e4uf47NXod-2xF_aMHRhSZRA24jzYQcFGeYOmP9Dbb9yP3KWP4zVmR17FtUqVcamad1YitH5PUSraqKYXwrzA_vkKN3r-BROlPEm0y98wFT3XWIf_V9tkg4NxNVupY2c0mYSgdrwoEAlJ5bqV_hOu_GWddCqXI-_SOmapCT19NpNcX-bauHpbjHke2fQL7FU8WZvYqOHq9bgQAnSbTZQSzkRvSL-tvvt0KMsln5gbVlTXcRTPaeffMi5qxQu2azqyExfOPBH9QF7AkPiUHszaXYSB6cXBGjwOKDQpdA9Zjgm7XMQael2howyubgJXcIASl-dvTuLpfIVilkrqCmrGsQs4hm2dTE7lx-hNbD9CyhDnojMynF7e7PbpIq2qaNcSxY2VqBniPLAcQ3al30N_8vdU3P1jg4QwhPHQKV)
---
| | Fellow American, There is a powerful movement in our culture to teach young Americans that our nation's history is **oppressive** and **shameful**. Sometimes, this effort goes under the name "critical race theory." Other times, activists advance these ideas through works like _The_ _New York Times_ '_ _ "1619 Project."

This radical movement pushes a narrative that slavery, not freedom, is the defining characteristic of American history. They teach our children that we should replace equal individual rights with the idea of unequal rights based on group identity.
---
| | **Hillsdale College is committed to countering this destructive ideology. That 's why we have produced a new, free online course titled ["Civil Rights in American History."](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=70a38a34ca754f4584e2bfc8457b7c9a&_e=iEhU_leDXpWWxHxhy53TGUbb1e4uf47NXod-2xF_aMHRhSZRA24jzYQcFGeYOmP9Dbb9yP3KWP4zVmR17FtUqVcamad1YitH5PUSraqKYXwrzA_vkKN3r-BROlPEm0y98wFT3XWIf_V9tkg4NxNVupY2c0mYSgdrwoEAlJ5bqV_hOu_GWddCqXI-_SOmapCT19NpNcX-bauHpbjHke2fQL7FU8WZvYqOHq9bgQAnSbTZQSzkRvSL-tvvt0KMsln5gbVlTXcRTPaeffMi5qxQu2azqyExfOPBH9QF7AkPiUGN0G_ENF_SEQn4YoDsoGgL2NWdenzM3ToO_Ryt30Dr6vsHyojVceKpu7fA3Ered9--FcqKggD8MChdcg56o0vU-Bpgy9ZCnb0aTxSJlunWSuAhxK4YCZMixYDh2qZaVSlXiS5hyCPz3ICso_YFbzqB) And right now, it is available in a special, limited DVD box set.** When you take this course, you'll learn about:
* How our Founding Founders understood equality, natural rights, and civil rights.
* The quest for justice in America through the Civil War, during Reconstruction, and in the 20th century.
* The danger posed to freedom and civil rights today by identity politics.

---

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | Dear Fellow American, Perhaps no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny than Winston Churchill. Not only did he diagnose the threat of modern technology, but he also spoke most effectively against the idea of socialism. So, it should come as no surprise to learn that so many "academics" and activists are working to smear Churchill's legacy. That's why studying an accurate account of his accomplishments is more important than ever. This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2ebf27ed958d455f85789ea6f1ca4b25&_e=yxXFNb3mCj7ott49RB4KUiJp2H2KkpWqjflqXQd3KIO9ZKyPiWFqbqhZY8Lh2ewn59Ti2fvMA2iWc3I-KsawqxRy35Yinu0dw3F_0pMzsoR3WmGIw1BBB6DarwOa0LkNwzVAtb3px3QXj7Fm7kC9Qjjv7_k3HZQWJtEGusdHWluOp7XstyW6EojMvYKL329_0v9hZhMMd1YHLgHVzgoGP53asZyRCDu0PvLZPKzpOfIiPUCEAI1TMrStnxHGAe_2byNrlpdPLFQODLHtxLkycJjguw435SBzeywcfVZ-WCPtkpJAEi4D7A39dh4JJdkAuE-jSYqeLGZBUXEo3Yn2NeV7-jSd9Bi8Fh_FgIPbw8s6zT8v3VOISlaHUjXJ2Crvv_mHi1xFS5InIodg_ySjGobEnmTlRP2sf_KicRvP_G8%3D)

| | Dear Fellow American, Perhaps no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny than Winston Churchill. Not only did he diagnose the threat of modern technology, but he also spoke most effectively against the idea of socialism. | | Fellow American, There is a powerful movement in our culture to teach young Americans that our nation's history is **oppressive** and **shameful**. Sometimes, this effort goes under the name "critical race theory." Other times, activists advance these ideas through works like _The_ _New York Times_ '_ _ "1619 Project."

Two largely overlooked issues, in particular, reveal the disturbing co-optation of Democrats--including President Biden--by their supposed nemesis.
If familiarity with U.S. history ever became a requirement for federal office, most of Congress would be disqualified immediately.
No one should be surprised given the pattern. But outrage remains thoroughly appropriate--especially considering that the right-wing Supreme Court actually earned its salt last week by defying the conservative consensus currently dominating Congress.
### **Government ethics**
When I ran for Congress, one of the particular issues animating my 2022 campaign was the [bipartisan corruption](https://substack.com/redirect/873732d3-e6f3-4d0d-877f-43ae50f95ea5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of federal policymakers, [including the one I ran against](https://substack.com/redirect/691700fa-008b-405a-82ef-8955d2952835?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Corruption can take many forms. I've written about the pattern of [executive intelligence agencies co-opting](https://substack.com/redirect/c734a696-2559-425f-876b-528cfb4d6dc7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Senate and House Intelligence Committees, for instance, and how that has left everything from mass surveillance to torture with impunity immune from constitutional restraints given the courts' absurd and self-marginalizing adoption, and recurring extensions, of the [so-called State Secrets Privilege](https://substack.com/redirect/eb608ac8-b362-4683-9265-1be0b30bf63a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
But corruption also has more straightforward facets. Recognizing them does not require replicating rocket science.
[Give a gift subscription](https://substack.com/redirect/59f8016c-3127-4d9f-81f0-077f257d7f66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
When policymakers profit from their offices, it is not merely offensive. It's also flatly unconstitutional. The Constitution's [Emoluments Clause](https://substack.com/redirect/8d12f94d-342d-400c-8b37-06c685eb9085?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) prohibits self-enrichment in office, and would have been the key to [bringing Trump down](https://substack.com/redirect/4fe1b3a1-cabe-46d0-b1c9-46b0c5ff289e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) had Democrats actually wanted to do so through their theatrical impeachment sagas from 2019-2021.
That very same Emoluments Clause that [Pelosi infamously refused to include](https://substack.com/redirect/a3999431-f989-4aa6-a154-29fc90da4412?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Trump's Articles of Impeachment would also prohibit figures like her from the insider trading that she and so many of her colleagues on both sides of the aisle have unapologetically embraced. Could that explain why they never forced Trump to answer for what amounts to theft from taxpayers?
Just wait. It gets worse.
Two elected Democrats in Washington are currently facing criminal prosecutions for bribery. Predictably, their colleagues have raced to their defense--perhaps because they each fear that, should either of them face the proverbial music, they themselves might be next in line.
### **With Democrats like this, who needs Republicans?**
Senator Bob Menendez (D-NJ) & his wife were [recently indicted](https://substack.com/redirect/15d14101-20ef-4ada-9c89-c871fd5d2530?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on 16 federal charges including bribery, fraud, acting as a foreign agent, and obstruction of justice. His trial began last week, and will explore his allegedly illegal receipt of hundreds of thousands of dollars of bribes in various forms such as mortgage payments, a Mercedes-Benz convertible, and gold bars, in exchange for help assisting the governments of Qatar and Egypt.
While overshadowed by another criminal trial just up the coast in Manhattan involving another federal politician from the other corporate party, the prosecution of Sen. Menendez has equally momentous implications.
Federal prosecutor Lara Pomerantz began the trial by [explaining](https://substack.com/redirect/efda09d8-5dbc-442b-b56d-804b48341efc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to jurors that:
> This case is about a public official who put greed first, who put his own interests above the duty to the people, who put his power up for sale. This was not politics as usual. This was politics for profit.
Sound familiar?
Menendez isn't the only Democrat in Washington whose record resembles that of disgraced former president Donald Trump.
Henry Cuellar (D-TX) is a Democrat in name only outrageously [endorsed](https://substack.com/redirect/0cb94514-0555-49d2-8d6a-441e90012df4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by my former opponent, Nancy Pelosi, despite openly opposing reproductive rights. Like Menendez in the Senate, Cuellar is facing federal bribery charges related to his undisclosed agency on behalf of foreign governments.
Cuellar allegedly accepted [over half a million dollars in bribes](https://substack.com/redirect/8ba8e238-6597-4d4e-a8c1-9eb5d9e3d6bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to advance the interests of a fossil fuel company owned by the government of Azerbaijan, as well as bank based in Mexico City.
Of course, elected Democrats [fell over each other](https://substack.com/redirect/128943c9-9b21-445d-ad88-5413d3568cdc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) coming to their colleagues' defense. House Minority Leader [Hakeem Jeffries](https://substack.com/redirect/79f67fa3-2c72-41be-8b1e-cb833e9e5dde?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) reminded observers of the presumption of innocence, while failing to observe that it is [effectively denied](https://substack.com/redirect/bfaff3dc-d770-4973-a68c-d82f5b9a5844?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on a daily basis to many less powerful defendants swept up in the wars on drugs or terror.
### **A surprising chink in the armor**
Ironically, the Supreme Court--which has reduced itself to a walking poster child for government corruption, in the wake of recurring scandals implicating [Justices taking what amount to bribes](https://substack.com/redirect/2026a42e-0d8a-4595-836a-59e2ec0fe939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from conservative parties appearing before the Court--managed to display a little independence over the past week.
In the wake of the 2008 financial crisis, Congress passed a law establishing a new agency, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, to oversee banks and guard the interests of consumers. The [brainchild of Senator Liz Warren](https://substack.com/redirect/29395a84-d9a8-4e3b-abfa-3e6865edfe6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (D-MA), the CFPB has become a partisan lightning rod, drawing consistent attacks from Republicans and any number of corporate lobbies.
One of those lobbies, in the form of an association of payday lenders, took a shot at the CFPB by mounting [a constitutional challenge to the agency's legitimacy](https://substack.com/redirect/523b2e3c-8e38-4b1e-9970-a7c542426598?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). While this particular appeal was directed at the CFPB, the broader conservative legal strategy aims to de-legitimate the administrative state generally, shrinking the government and hamstringing its ability to guard labor from the recurring excesses of capital.
Yet, when this widely watched case from this year's Supreme Court term was finally resolved last week, [a 7-2 majority emerged upholding the CFPB](https://substack.com/redirect/2e226c75-f833-4080-8351-7b20a79ee12e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), despite the consistent allegiance to business interests shared by give Justices comprising a majority of the Court.
One might wonder whether the conservatives who thought they bought the Court may be feeling some buyers' remorse. Frankly, two possibilities seem more likely to me.
First, the Justices and their patrons in Big Business may be biding their time, waiting to rule in favor of Wall Street in future cases. After all, every issue that reaches the Court is likely to do so again. It took 50 years for the conservative legal movement to [dismantle reproductive rights](https://substack.com/redirect/0d5e514e-d757-472f-a089-776661183107?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)‚ and it might have the patience to trace a similar timeline in the effort to unravel federal consumer protection efforts and unleash Wall Street's predatory power on the American people once again.
Alternatively, the Justices may be demonstrating their fealty not to business in general, but rather only the particular patrons who have bankrolled them and their lavish lifestyles. Justice Thomas, in particular, has accepted an astounding number of [remarkable gifts](https://substack.com/redirect/2026a42e-0d8a-4595-836a-59e2ec0fe939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from billionaires, including what NPR [summarized](https://substack.com/redirect/c060cdd0-23b5-463f-85bc-7bcf5ac79111?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as "at least 38 vacations, 26 private jet flights, eight flights by helicopter, a dozen VIP passes to sporting events, as well as stays at luxury resorts in Florida and Jamaica."
Yet, even though MyPillow CEO Mike Lindell has [spent over $25 million](https://substack.com/redirect/3b68bd1a-04e8-474a-94ea-3ef81232f3a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) promoting lies about the 2020 election (and reportedly [going broke](https://substack.com/redirect/516b381f-d1f4-4efe-920b-e4577a92575f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the process), the Court has recently rejected two of his appeals. Most recently, the Court [chose last month](https://substack.com/redirect/fa8d7078-7ecc-4cc8-adaa-abdbf82ee461?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to reject his attempt to challenge the seizure of his phone by FBI agents at a Hardee's drive-in.
Two years ago, the Court also voted to [reject](https://substack.com/redirect/bd314987-40ac-49a7-b43c-7d2862b868f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Lindell's politicized [request](https://substack.com/redirect/98e46057-6ba1-4bcf-ab28-16ac8688b2e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to appeal a defamation suit from Dominion Voting Systems. Lindell's appeal cited previous rulings by Justice Thomas inviting the Court to overturn _New York Times v. Sullivan_ , the precent that I aim to uphold in my continuing [election integrity lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/514dd25d-6e45-4629-9c5f-1215a7a6ff48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against the Hearst Corporation and San Francisco Chronicle.
Justice Thomas, at appears, is either an unreliable ally to business leaders, or at least an insufficient one.
### **Embracing restrictions on dissent**
In addition to supporting the same disregard for congressional ethics as Republicans, Democrats have also enthusiastically [embraced restrictions on domestic dissent](https://substack.com/redirect/1e402a31-7107-4667-a445-c03214799e1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Earlier this month, [Biden cheered on attacks by local police](https://substack.com/redirect/cd4d6e0d-9260-48c4-ac55-db552b2a5b4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) departments targeting student activists, trying to draw an arbitrary distinction between what he described as "dissent" and "disorder." His comments ultimately revealed [his ignorance of U.S. history](https://substack.com/redirect/0da29c11-e60e-4fc1-a6f2-3d06eba25f84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and the Constitution. In fact, the United States was born from acts of expression that boldly embraced disorder. So were [civil rights](https://substack.com/redirect/c7e8e5d5-a0bb-46b7-9d3b-ccb85a632ed8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and the [end of the Vietnam War](https://substack.com/redirect/19e5d14a-551c-4c61-baaf-7762dc0635f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Biden was far from alone, however. Elected Democrats scrambled to support his ignorant comments, revealing their own disdain for democracy and the constitutional rights on which it rests.
For example, Senator Mark Kelly (D-AZ) [said on Meet the Press](https://substack.com/redirect/f1a88112-1e7f-4a56-b550-1fbdb1c5216e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that some of the [protests at universities](https://substack.com/redirect/c6b2361f-0e51-48c7-9141-9b216e0ea2b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across the country had "become very violent, and...they've gotten out of control." Kelly went on to say that "Everybody has the right to protest peacefully. But when it turns into unlawful acts--and we've seen this in a number of colleges and universities including here in Arizona--it's appropriate for the police to step in."
If familiarity with U.S. history ever became a requirement for federal office, most of Congress would be disqualified immediately.
Eric Adams, the right wing Democrat serving as the Mayor of New York, said on [ABC News This Week](https://substack.com/redirect/cfde6d97-dfcb-4b2b-8583-4f22930f3aa1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that "When...protests reach the point of violence, we have to ensure that we use a minimum amount of force to terminate what is perceived to be a threat." Adams conveniently overlooked the [brutality](https://substack.com/redirect/ff5c7e4d-68c4-42f6-8031-3677e6dc8f70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with which the New York Police Department cracked down on student protests at Columbia University.
Jon Ben-Menachem, a Jewish fourth-year Ph.D. sociology student at Columbia, [explained the fallacy](https://substack.com/redirect/ff5c7e4d-68c4-42f6-8031-3677e6dc8f70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Adams overlooked. Despite claims of alleged antisemitism on campus, Ben-Menachem made clear that "The biggest threat to Jewish safety on campus is the arrests...We're terrified that there'll be another Kent State or Jackson State at Columbia."
Other students who have feared state violence responding to their constitutionally protected political speech include [Black students at Southern universities](https://substack.com/redirect/4a220d7b-0283-43af-ae4d-9329e2015c4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) such as Emory and Morehouse in Atlanta. Yet, despite the storied legacy of Morehouse alumni such as Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.--whose [calls for peace in the face of U.S. militarism](https://substack.com/redirect/397f9243-0b0f-402a-80a9-2b24c2478a29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) turned him into a national pariah and then a national hero--the university recently [hosted President "Genocide Joe" Biden](https://substack.com/redirect/ec0ff898-9860-45f7-b6fa-6eebb97a47e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for its commencement address.
Widespread controversy on the Morehouse campus driven by [outraged](https://substack.com/redirect/85e352d2-e3ec-4686-9454-a4da1101065d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) students and faculty was ultimately stifled, leading at least one Black scholar who remembers Dr. King's legacy--Dr. Cornel West, who is [pivotally challenging Biden](https://substack.com/redirect/d9a3bbc6-9c61-4cb0-b29d-8777c196f026?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the White House--to forcefully [speak out](https://substack.com/redirect/a10a1f02-2e3e-4d1e-a539-cf779890fa45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Democrats who declare themselves hostile to the First Amendment and the Constitution are hypocrites in more ways than one. Not only are their oaths of office demonstrably empty, but they repeat the assaults on democracy that they [rightfully decry](https://substack.com/redirect/41861246-b55d-479c-ab65-69b2b5d88cd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from former president Trump.
### **Bipartisan authoritarianism unites Washington**
I've written before about how [fascism in the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/ce4d3c4e-2f80-40d7-9f7b-542d488a4e03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has grown well-established in both parties, despite the opportunistic bleating by Democrats about the need to protect democracy.
Beyond their disregard for the rights of working Americans, the very same Democrats have more recently endorsed attacks on dissent, as well as constitutional violations by their colleagues who have subverted their offices in the service of their own fortunes.
As our country races headlong into an [obvious farce of a presidential election](https://substack.com/redirect/754cbf0e-5352-4e9f-80d6-fe62039908cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) dominated by septuagenarian oligarchs who ducked primary debates, the complicity of Democrats across the country with their Republican colleagues reveals--yet again--that We, the People, have few allies in Washington.

# WHO WILL BE
# VIRGINIA'S
# U.S. SENATE
# REPUBLICAN NOMINEE?

# WHY I'M SUPPORTING
CHUCK SMITH
#

# VOTE TUESDAY, JUNE 18
---
---
|
# CHUCK SMITH
# REPUBLICAN FOR U.S. SENATE
---
|
Friends, Remember when I stood in the streets of Richmond for a pro-2A gun rally and BLM and Antifa showed up as well?
Chuck Smith was right there with me. Standing up for our Second Amendment rights. Standing up for keeping our historical monuments. Unapologetically.
I've served in the political trenches since 2008 and I've never heard of or seen any of these folks running for U.S. Senate until they announced they were running for U.S. Senate. I'm sure they are good people, but where have they been and where were they during Covid when the unconstitutional mandates to force us to mask up, take the experimental vaccine and the fight to hold people accountable for stealing the 2020 presidential election?
No doubt these other candidates are good people who have a list of accomplishments, but where were they?
Remember, I was the legislator that led on the fight against these unconstitutional mandates and introduced legislation to go back to paper ballots and hand counts and was censured for exercising my First Amendment right to state the obvious- the 2020 presidential election was stolen. Remember when even Republicans like former VP Mike Pence betrayed the American people and certified the electors without resolving the concerns of We the People?
We need to elect America First, We the People First candidates who will fight for the people who elected them and stop giving in to the political uni-party.
Having worked for three U.S. Congressmen, I truly understand the pressure first hand. The Swamp attempts to crush any representative who dares to challenge the status quo, which is exactly why I'm very leery of well intended first time candidates who have never served in the political trenches until they decided to run for public office statewide. Most give in unfortunately. That's why we need someone who is tested and yet remains true.
The U.S. Senate Republican Primary is just around the corner and it's important that you educate yourself and know the difference between all of the candidates who have successfully collected their signatures and will appear on the ballot this coming June. Here's what you should know.
On Tuesday, June 18, 2024, Republicans will vote for and elect the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate. This seat is currently held by Democrat Senator Tim Kaine.
Many of you have asked who I am supporting for U.S. Senate.
After carefully listening to all of the candidates and doing my research, I'm supporting Chuck Smith.
In fact, 2 weeks ago, I decided to accept a request to join his team as Senior Advisor for the remaining weeks of the race. Why? Because I want to make sure he wins.
Why? Because I believe in Chuck. He has the grit and tenacity to challenge the status quo, not become part of it. He's a marine who I've seen first hand not give up when his back was against the wall.
You see, I've known Chuck Smith for over a 15 years. He had the guts to challenge Congressman Bobby Scott in the old 3rd Congressional District. It was a district that leaned heavily Democrat, but Chuck still answered the call. These Democrats need to be challenged and not given a pass just because they live in a district that leans Democrat.
When I was standing against unconstitutional Covid mandates, the big 2021 gun grab, the socialistic monument grab, the 2020 stealing of a presidential election and standing with J6ers who are being held as political enemies, there was only one of these candidates who stood with me in the fight.
That person was Chuck Smith.
Chuck Smith was one of the only politicians in the trenches and in the streets of Richmond standing with me to defend your Constitutional rights
Chuck is not a newcomer to Virginia politics. He served as the GOP Chair for the Virginia Beach Republican Party and successfully led Republicans to victory in all local, state and federal levels. Sorry, but where have these newcomers been? Have they been in the trenches with you and I for the past 4 years?
When President Trump ran for President the first time, many Republicans tried to keep some of President Trump's supporters from voting in the Republican Primary. Chuck successfully represented these supporters and won. Thanks to Chuck these Virginians were allowed to vote.
I truly believe all 5 candidates are good people and I'll support whoever the Republican nominee is, but I hope you will join me in casting a vote for Chuck Smith on Tuesday, June 18.
While I hope if elected the others would stand strong, I KNOW if elected Chuck will stand strong and not become apart of the DC Swamp.
Please donate Chuck's campaign by clicking the link below.
Chuck has a history of supporting President Trump, even from the very beginning. We can count him to support President Trump once elected so that we can truly make America Great Again!

WHY I'M SUPPORTING CHUCK SMITH VOTE TUESDAY, JUNE 18 | CHUCK SMITH REPUBLICAN FOR U.S. SENATE | Friends, Remember when I stood in the streets of Richmond for a pro-2A gun rally and BLM and Antifa showed up as well? Chuck Smith was right there with me. Standing up for our Second Amendment rights. Standing up for keeping our historical monuments. Unapologetically. I've served in the political trenches since 2008 and I've never heard of or seen any of these folks running for U.S. Senate until they announced they were running for U.S. Senate. I'm sure they are good people, but where have they been and where were they during Covid when the unconstitutional mandates to force us to mask up, take the experimental vaccine and the fight to hold people accountable for stealing the 2020 presidential election? No doubt these other candidates are good people who have a list of accomplishments, but where were they? Remember, I was the legislator that led on the fight against these unconstitutional mandates and introduced legislation to go back to paper ballots and hand counts and was censured for exercising my First Amendment right to state the obvious- the 2020 presidential election was stolen. Remember when even Republicans like former VP Mike Pence betrayed the American people and certified the electors without resolving the concerns of We the People? We need to elect America First, We the People First candidates who will fight for the people who elected them and stop giving in to the political uni-party. The Swamp attempts to crush any representative who dares to challenge the status quo, which is exactly why I'm very leery of well intended first time candidates who have never served in the political trenches until they decided to run for public office statewide. Most give in unfortunately. That's why we need someone who is tested and yet remains true. The U.S. Senate Republican Primary is just around the corner and it's important that you educate yourself and know the difference between all of the candidates who have successfully collected their signatures and will appear on the ballot this coming June. Here's what you should know. On Tuesday, June 18, 2024, Republicans will vote for and elect the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate. This seat is currently held by Democrat Senator Tim Kaine. Many of you have asked who I am supporting for U.S. Senate. After carefully listening to all of the candidates and doing my research, I'm supporting Chuck Smith. In fact, 2 weeks ago, I decided to accept a request to join his team as Senior Advisor for the remaining weeks of the race. Why? Because I want to make sure he wins. Why? Because I believe in Chuck. He has the grit and tenacity to challenge the status quo, not become part of it. He's a marine who I've seen first hand not give up when his back was against the wall. You see, I've known Chuck Smith for over a 15 years. He had the guts to challenge Congressman Bobby Scott in the old 3rd Congressional District. It was a district that leaned heavily Democrat, but Chuck still answered the call. These Democrats need to be challenged and not given a pass just because they live in a district that leans Democrat. When I was standing against unconstitutional Covid mandates, the big 2021 gun grab, the socialistic monument grab, the 2020 stealing of a presidential election and standing with J6ers who are being held as political enemies, there was only one of these candidates who stood with me in the fight. May 21, 2024
Last night the 4th Congressional District Republican Party voted to Endorse my candidacy to represent the Party in the race to unseat Jim Himes on Nov. 5th. I've been campaigning across the district for the past year, and the faith placed in me by the delegates is both humbling and gratifying. But the race is not about me, it's about returning genuine representation to the solid citizens of the 4th District. And that work resumes again today with new momentum and urgency. Thanks so much to all who have helped propel the campaign this far. We'll need everyone pulling on the same end of the rope as the election cycle develops. Please forward the news to any and all who are interested in helping to advance our mission. McGuire has a clear record of 100% support for our 2nd Amendment. As the Virginia Citizens Defense League PAC said last year about John in the past, "John has a 100% voting record. With a 100 score from VCDL every year, John has always worked tirelessly within our community to support and defend one of our most fundamental freedoms. McGuire has a perfect pro-gun voting record and has fought for Constitutional carry, sovereign immunity, and so many more pro-2A policies.
Please join me in voting for John June 18, Republican Primary for Congress."

Ed Coleman, Firearms Instructor & Consultant

| McGuire said: "Thank you to Ed Coleman for your support for our campaign and our 2nd Amendment rights. As a father, I taught my children everything they needed to know about handling a firearm safely, and about the rights that are guaranteed to them by God, and protected by the United States Constitution. As a Navy SEAL for over ten years, I defended our nation and our Constitution against all enemies, both foreign and domestic. As a Delegate, I have a perfect proven record of standing up for our Second Amendment right and working to repeal infringements to the same. With your support, I will continue my fight in Congress. We must win in June and give President Trump a Congress that 100% supports his America First Agenda."

body:
Important housekeeping for Thursday

| | | | **FELLOW PATRIOTS:**
Just some housekeeping for Texas Flynn Fest on Thursday...
_**Seating:**_ We've sold almost 400 tickets for Texas Flynn Fest and seating is very limited, so if you want to make sure you have a seat, no questions asked, please bring a lawn chair or tailgating chair with you!
_**Venue:**_ Sawyer Park Icehouse 314 Pruitt Rd Spring, TX 77380
Sawyer Park Icehouse is an indoor/outdoor venue, but our event specifically will be outdoors and the bulk of the event will take place in the evening. However, the indoor area is available during the day if you need to cool off.
_**Dress Code:**_ This is an outdoor event, so dress comfortably!
_**Food/Drinks:**_ Food and drinks are self-pay.
_**Drawings/Giveaways:**_ We will be doing some drawings and giveaways for a firearm and a few other goodies!
_**Schedule:**_ **All Ticket Holders:**
* **4:00 pm - 7:00 pm:** Vendors, Food, Drinks, Activities, Drawings
* **6:00 pm:** FLYNN Movie Display Presentation, Media and Red Carpet Activities Begin
* **7:30 pm - 9:30 pm:** FLYNN Movie Begins
* **9:30 pm - 9:45 pm:** Short Intermission
* **9:45 pm - 10:45 pm:** LIVE Audience Q&A; w/ General Flynn and Special Guests

**VIP Ticket Holders:**
* 6:00 pm: Exclusive Private Meet & Greet w/ General Flynn

Make sure to pick up your tickets today if you haven't already: [https://texasflynnfest.com](https://jamesonellis.lt.acemlna.com/Prod/link-tracker?redirectUrl=aHR0cHMlM0ElMkYlMkZ0ZXhhc2ZseW5uZmVzdC5jb20=&sig=cEGfCpYhkc4AzQF8bjTR1yGWGvDgXUazZ3cz2Q6tckQ&iat=1716309976&a=%7C%7C611311006%7C%7C&account=jamesonellis%2Eactivehosted%2Ecom&email=yVMmqN9oqo8lpEi8C42Jg7O5Sw6ymAz641DrTn7%2BZSkI22jf%3A3fgeWpX%2BEOw%2B9eWAd46VHdTPCoqPUXYn&s=cabcbe31a720242486b887158a77876f&i=260A302A1A2326)

**WHAT ARE YOU WILLING TO FIGHT FOR?** ****
****Retired General and former National Security Advisor Mike Flynn joins Brian Tally as they talk about the 35th and final stop of the FLYNN movie premiere and Texas Flynn Fest, presented by Jameson Ellis & Project Defiant.

General Flynn has been on the road touring America since the beginning of April, telling his story to thousands of people as he opens up and personally shares his testimony and new documentary, "FLYNN: Deliver the Truth. Whatever the Cost."

The grand finale is this Thursday, May 23rd, in Spring, Texas.

**[State taxpayers to lose $2.8 billion in TABOR refunds due to legislature, study shows](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
As a result of 101 bills passed by the Colorado legislature, over $2.8 billion in state TABOR refunds will not go to Colorado taxpayers between 2024 and 2026, according to a recent report from the [Common Sense Institute](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

The [$2.8 billion loss](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) is just less than half of the projected $6 billion in TABOR refunds for the next three years, CSI found in its report following the 2024 Colorado legislative session.

"Legislators [focused intensely on TABOR refunds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) this session," CSI Mike A. Leprino Fellow Lang Sias said in a statement.

"What started a few years ago," he said, "has snowballed into what we saw play out during the 2024 session where more than 100 bills redirected TABOR refunds."
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Federal judge rules against Biden's expansion of gun background checks](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A federal judge, Matthew J. Kacsmaryk, [ruled against](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) President Biden's expansion of gun background checks, stating that it likely violates federal law.
* The judge argued that the administration stretched the definition of those ["engaged in the business"](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) of firearms too far, potentially ensnaring law-abiding gun owners who primarily keep weapons for self-defense or protection.
* The ruling issued a [temporary restraining order](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) blocking the policy in Texas and for members of certain gun-rights groups, hindering enforcement of the entire policy.
* The Biden administration's expansion aimed to close the "gun show loophole" by [requiring background checks for nondealers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) selling firearms, potentially adding 20,000 people to the current list of those requiring checks.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Understanding the complexity of Colorado's rainwater collection laws](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado allows rainwater collection on private property but imposes restrictions on who can collect it, how much they can collect, and how it can be used, as per the [Colorado Division of Water Resources](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* Residents living in apartment or condominium buildings with more than four units are prohibited from collecting rainwater. Individuals can own up to two rain barrels but [cannot store more than 110 gallons](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) of collected water at a time, with lids required to prevent mosquito breeding.
* The collected rainwater can only be used for [outdoor purposes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) like lawn and garden maintenance, car washing, livestock watering, and hot tub filling; indoor use and drinking water are not permitted.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[RFK, Jr. kicks off Independent petition drive to get on Colorado ballot at Aurora rally](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Independent presidential candidate Robert F. Kennedy Jr. launched a [petition drive at a rally in Aurora](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to get on Colorado's fall ballot, aiming to mend the country's division by focusing on what unites Americans.
* Kennedy criticized the [political status quo](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), arguing that reelecting President Joe Biden or former President Trump won't bring the desired change.
* Kennedy's campaign aims to [gather 12,000 signatures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to qualify for the Colorado ballot, with the goal of collecting over 20,000 signatures in the next two weeks.
* Kennedy emphasized his intention to address issues like [environmental protection and budget deficits](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), contrasting his approach with what he sees as the major parties' focus on divisive cultural issues.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[COMMENTARY: Jokes about our legislature used to be funny](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MARK HILLMAN, [MARKHILLMAN.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_We used to joke that "no man's life, liberty or property is safe while the legislature is in session." That's no laughing matter in today's Colorado._
_The collective sigh heard across our state when 100 legislators finally went home to mind their own business reflects the growing sense of dread that accompanies the Colorado General Assembly convening each January._
_Although some of their worst ideas died on May 8 when the annual session ended, many of them will rise again like zombies next January, and Coloradans will again be subjected to this same ritual._
_Not long ago, Democrats and Republicans argued mostly about whether taxes and government spending should be higher or lower. But as Democrats achieved super-majority status - now 46-19 in the House and 23-12 in the Senate - they're confident voters gave them a mandate and won't hold them accountable for their excesses._

Does Democracy have a palm card?
You know - those larger-than-business-card, smaller-than-a-poster things that candidates hand out at meet-and-greets.
Thanks for reading Paula's Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..oYAK0LdJ9Ur18-lyI_0SqqlbYxTxxU_Wjq-tr-QETKE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=144836535)
I have palm cards. I have door hangers for when I go out in the communities. I have banners, and car magnets. Soon we will see yard signs and T Shirts. It's 2024 and climate change is real; campaign-branded water bottles will help get the word out and keep people hydrated as well.
But I feel like re-doing all of them and putting the real candidate on my signage: DEMOCRACY.
**I am but a placeholder for the real issue on the ballot, which is our very existence as a democratic nation.**
Well-intended Democrats corner me at events. "I need to know your platform."
Platform? Yes I have one. Immigration, Climate, Healthcare, Dobbs, Jobs - you name it. I check all of the boxes.
During petitioning, I had one guy at a Democratic county committee meeting tell me he needed to know where I stood because he flatly could not support any candidate who remained uncommitted to restoring the labor platform of the 1970s. Seriously. People ask the darndest things of their candidates.
Then there is the resume question. A few of you are a little bit hazy on mine ("What exactly does a cannabis attorney do?"). I try not to get caught in the weeds (pun intended) in those conversations.
Back to the platform question. Listen - this is serious. **My platform is democracy**. And I'm not ashamed to get in-your-face, and more than a little bit aggressive about that.
There is a thing called Project 2025. If we send the wrong people back to Washington, it won't matter what's on my resume, what I do for a living, or whether I have any platform at all from any decade.
If we send the MAGAs back to Washington, they have a 920-page written plan to dismantle our Democracy.
This is not campaign rhetoric. Search online for it: Project 2025. It is real. I won't hyper-link to it because I don't want to give it anymore clicks, nor bounce it up in the algorithms by linking it to my blog.
**Here is how Project 2025 will work** : they will start with replacing federal civil service workers with their own people. They laid the groundwork for this in the prior Trump administration by changing the civil service rules. Biden un-did those rules. They will revise the rules once elected. Then they will work from within to dismantle the various and numerous federal agencies. By the way, North Country - they want to start with dissolving the EPA.
Pardon me while I go off on a Project 2025 tangent. Remember a few years ago when they started cutting and relocating agencies? They relocated the USDA and the Bureau of Land Management (twice), causing a federal workers to have to choose between unemployment and relocation. Project 2025 also includes cuts to Medicare, Social Security, and the Affordable Care Act programs. They will rescind the caps on drug prices that Biden accomplished. Veterans - Stefanik's pet demographic - should know that Trump administration will attack the VA, shrink benefits, reorganize, dispose of much of the disability programming, reclassify many who now qualify for benefits such as those for treatment of Agent Orange exposure, privatize a certain portion of the care, and end any labor contracts for VA-related workers.
Abortion bans will become the rule of law throughout the states, starting with women in the military.
Ultimately, the federal system will become one of an autocratic state, rather than a democratic state.
Back to my platform: I'm fighting for our democracy. I'm fighting so that Project 2025 becomes the topic of academic studies, rather than the rule of the land.
**It 's as if our house is on fire.**
If your house were truly on fire, would you ask the firefighter what his platform was, or his strategy for winning at firefighting?
Would you ask the firefighter how he planned to find enough money to supply the water and the equipment to fight the fire?
Would you ask about his captain, or his organization?
Would you want to know if the fire truck was state-of the art, or was it not quite the shiniest and newest equipment available in the firefighting industry?
Would you take time to grill him as to whether he had enough supporters, and somewhat shame him if you didn't like his answer?
Would you stand on the porch, house ablaze, and tell him that there's no way he can win against this blazing inferno of a fire? And why didn't he hire people to handle this before now?
Heck no!
If your house were on fire, you would jump up and down and urge that one lonely firefighter to do all he could do to stamp out the fire! And then you would run to the neighbors and get them to help. You'd gather buckets and hoses. And then you would ask everyone in sight to either pitch in and help with the fire, or else run to the next block and get other people to come put out the fire.
**Scream. Shout. Do something, and do it now! The house is on fire!**
The Capitol House in DC was darn near on fire on January 6, 2021. Our Democracy is still on fire as we speak.
This is all hands on deck. This is time to talk to your entire network of friends, real-life and in cyber space. Post something (positive and straight-forward) online. Share the links. Tell others. Attend an event. Make phone calls.
Get involved. I've got thousands of postcards that need to go out, and I have already printed the mailing labels. I just need people to affix little adhesive labels. Reach out and I'll meet you somewhere to get them to you. Your choice as to whether to provide postage as a contribution to the campaign, or whether you need me to foot the bill out-of-pocket (my own pocket; not campaign dollars).
Canvass. Go door to door with palm cards. Again - reach out. I'll get the door hangers to you.
Whatever you CAN do, do it. And do it now. Forget the gripes about money or questions about whether I have enough paid staffers (I don't, by the way, but my paid digital staff is in place and texting, calling, and emailing donors all over the country and within the district. In-district field operators start in late June).
**Get into action now. Not for me. For the real candidate, which is Democracy. **
We are Democrats. We have NOTHING to be ashamed of. Our guy, Joseph Biden, came into office after a jaw-dropping attack on our nation's capitol, during the worst global pandemic of our generation. Our guy - yes, the old guy with the sunshades - created the most jobs that have ever been recorded (ever - not just restoration of the pre-Covid layoffs), appropriated funds to repair and create infrastructure, lowered prescription drug prices, and reduced student loans. And he is just getting started.
I am a strong and bold Democrat. I'm the strong and bold firefighter standing on your porch to help put out the blaze.
If you're wondering why you don't see me continuously schmoozing with the Dems in the district, it's 'cause I'm doing things like going on conservative AM talk radio (speaking of walking into a fire). And about 1 out of 3 or 4 of the callers actually tells me that I have their vote. That's amazing, isn't it? Kind of makes up for the other people who call the radio show to yell at me.
But I do need your help. Go next door. Tell everyone in town. This is serious and if we wait another second there will be nothing left of our democratic form of government to save.
**There is a self-defeating malaise in NY21 that is formidable. I call it Democratic Despair.**
It's that syndrome that causes people to say that the Democratic candidates' campaigns don't have enough money, so how could they possibly win? It's that thing that causes Democrats to say about me, in particular, "Yeah - she's OK. But nobody can beat Stefanik."
Here's another one: "Last time Stefanik had a huge sign. Her face was on it. Everyone could see it when they came into town."
Well, honestly, I have enough money to do that. I could buy huge signs with my face on it for every town in the district. Would that cut through your Democratic Despair?
I get it. It's that depression that follows 10 years of watching a formerly-moderate conservative representative morph into someone who proudly calls herself an Ultra Maga, with all of the attendant party support that accompanies that identity.
It's that catatonic shock that all of us have over Trump and the MAGAs and, "How the heck did any of this happen in our country?" The postlude to that oratorio is "Remember when we thought George W was the worst?"
Take a deep breath and remember that NY21 includes Fort Ticonderoga, the site of a significant win for the American Revolutionary War. There were only 83 American soldiers there to overtake the British. (By the way, Benedict Arnold was on the American side there.) The largest single gathering of American soldiers in any one battle was estimated to be 13,000. We have a lot more Democrats than that in NY21. And don't forget the 1 in 4 callers on those AM talk radio shows I've been on.
I realize: times are different. We aren't American Revolutionary soldiers. But we are, once again, in the fight for our identity, our form of government, and our freedom.
**How can you help? **
The obvious: instead of telling others that any of the Democratic candidates on the November ballot can't win because they don't have enough money, how about sending in some money? That's fair, isn't it? Even a dollar would make a difference. The state and local races have matching funds. Unfortunately, my race (a federal race) does not.
And if you don't have any money at all - understood. But then please refrain from telling others that the Democratic candidates don't have enough money and the Republicans have sooooo much money. In other words, if you can't help, please don't hurt. Constantly drilling down on the money issue becomes it's own spiral of defeat; people aren't going to contribute to a campaign if they don't believe the candidate has a chance of winning. Why throw away good money?
Groups of volunteers are mobilizing to walk through neighborhoods in each county. People are sending out postcards, targeting the non-party-affiliated registered voters.
Our next step will be gathering people to make phone calls. Yes - the annoying phone callers that we all hate, but who nonetheless make a difference in elections. Meanwhile I'm on the auto-dialer making no less than 100 calls a day - usually 200.
As we get closer to the election, we will need people to help with early voter registration, early absentee voting (the thing Elise has lost twice on in NY courts, which reinforces my claim that we are already winning), and early voting. Make people aware that they have so many ways to vote in New York now.
And the day of the election, we need people to drive voters to the polls who might not otherwise have a way to get there. Can you do that?
**How can you hurt Democratic candidates this election season?** **By spreading the Democratic Despair.** It's like a virus, and it can infect a room full of voters in something like 21 seconds. Next time you find yourself ready to say, "Such-and-such candidate doesn't stand a chance, because...(fill in the blank)", pause and ask yourself if you could re-frame the situation.
I'm not asking for pollyanna, but I would suggest that we could all benefit from some positive posturing. Myself, included.
Seriously do some soul-searching. Ask yourself, "Do I really want the Dems to win this election, or do I just like to hear to sound super smart as I point out my observations on so-and-so's campaign?" (or to read my writing on the screen, which is the 21st century equivalent).
Most Democrats are brainy people who analyze the heck out of everything. I am aware that ultimately, even the most unpleasant of the Democratic naysayers, are genuinely full of good intentions.
Additionally, most Democrats, and a reasonable number of non-Democrats, are full of hope that this longshot candidate (yours truly) can pull it off.
**Imagine the psychological blow to the Republicans if we could even narrow the margins in the Stefanik race. If you don 't think we can win, can you at least believe that we can narrow that gap and build on those wins for the midterms? **
Let's match each of those good intentions with good actions.
We can do this. But I really need you to shake that Democratic Despair.
Nobody thought the American Revolutionary troops could win against the British. Fort Ticonderoga - right here in NY21 was a turning point.
I'm no George Washington. But I don't have to be.
**It 's Democracy that's the real candidate on the ballot in 2024. I'm just the placeholder.**

I'm not asking for pollyanna, but I would suggest that we could all benefit from some positive posturing. Myself, included. Seriously do some soul-searching. Ask yourself, "Do I really want the Dems to win this election, or do I just like to hear to sound super smart as I point out my observations on so-and-so's campaign?" (or to read my writing on the screen, which is the 21st century equivalent). Most Democrats are brainy people who analyze the heck out of everything. I am aware that ultimately, even the most unpleasant of the Democratic naysayers, are genuinely full of good intentions. Additionally, most Democrats, and a reasonable number of non-Democrats, are full of hope that this longshot candidate (yours truly) can pull it off. Imagine the psychological blow to the Republicans if we could even narrow the margins in the Stefanik race. If you don 't think we can win, can you at least believe that we can narrow that gap and build on those wins for the midterms? Let's match each of those good intentions with good actions. We can do this. But I really need you to shake that Democratic Despair. Nobody thought the American Revolutionary troops could win against the British. Fort Ticonderoga - right here in NY21 was a turning point. I'm no George Washington. But I don't have to be. It 's Democracy that's the real candidate on the ballot in 2024. I'm just the placeholder.** Thanks for reading Paula's Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work. If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. | | | | | | | (C) 2024 Paula Collins 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?
