name: Andrew Yang
subject: GoodParty.org
body:
| |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=e820db15df&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
Hello, I hope that you are doing great. Hard to believe that Memorial Day is just a week away!

I spent part of the week out West in California. One of the best aspects of trying to make the world a better place is meeting other people who are trying to do the same thing. One of those people is Farhad Mohit, whom I interview on the [podcast](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=6e2e78b05d&e=0f227c2ae3) this week.

---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=5940147467&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
Farhad’s story is incredible – he immigrated to the U.S. from Iran as a child to California. Straight out of business school Farhad founded the consumer review website Bizrate and later the shopping search engine Shopzilla, both of which became big successes. He then founded Flipagram, which was acquired in 2017 by ByteDance and combined with [Musical.ly](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=a265728866&e=0f227c2ae3) to create a little-known app called TikTok. “I started one of the largest and fastest growing mobile apps of all time.”

Farhad’s mind went to bigger challenges. He concluded years ago that the American political system wasn’t going to lead to good things. “It was years ago at TED. I knew that the two existing parties weren’t going to lead to a desirable future for humanity. I thought, why don’t we just start a new party? But then I realized who I am and what I do. I build tech tools. Why don’t I start an organization that will build free tech tools for anyone running as an Independent so they can compete?”

That organization became GoodParty.org, which Farhad founded and now describes himself as ‘full-time volunteer.’ “We want to empower the young brand new candidate to be able to compete with the establishment. The majority of young people in particular don’t like the two parties. Want a press release or fundraising email? Our AI can produce that in moments. Our toolkit is getting better all of the time. And it’s totally free to any independent candidate. More viable independent candidates mean less money in politics, less corruption, and more solutions.”

Farhad is a patron of the arts and also founded Gifted Savings, a non-profit that is giving investments to adults in Ohio and high school seniors in Michigan so that they can create opportunities for themselves. No wonder we get along.

Yes, there’s a benevolent techie looking to level the playing field of politics. “I have the benefit of having made enough money so I can just focus on what’s important for the future of humanity. The symbol of GoodParty.org is a heart of love. That’s what the world needs.” GoodParty.org and Forward are teaming up to assist dozens – perhaps hundreds – of local candidates this cycle. Can we deliver what most people want? Farhad has made history a few times already – I wouldn’t bet against him doing it again.

For my interview of Farhad click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=2c5073c3cc&e=0f227c2ae3). To check out GoodParty.org’s tools click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=54fd6ce2f5&e=0f227c2ae3). To join Forward click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=03dab3a8b6&e=0f227c2ae3). My TED Talk is now up to more than 650,000 views and I get positive messages about it every day – you can see it [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=bbdcdb51c5&e=0f227c2ae3). Thank you for spreading the word!
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party

Dear Peter, With the election just 77 days away, I'm filled with a sense of profound possibility and historic significance. **This isn't just another campaign — it's a chance to make history together.** Did you realize that**out of the 2,003 individuals who have served as U.S. Senators since 1789, only 12 have been African American, and none hail from the State of Michigan**? Take a moment to absorb that. If elected, I would be the pioneer representing Michigan in the federal delegation, becoming the 13th African American ever elected to the United States Senate. This isn't just a milestone for me; it's a milestone for all of us. It's a testament to the progress we've made as a nation, but also a reminder of the work that still lies ahead. It's about breaking barriers, shattering glass ceilings, and opening doors of opportunity for generations to come. [**But I can't do it alone. I need your help to make history.**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1562?t=2&akid=1248%2E62735%2ENctL0r) **Rarely does an open Senate seat present itself; most elected senators serve until their passing. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to shape the future of Michigan and our nation's representation in Congress.** By joining our campaign today, you're not just supporting me — you're standing up for representation, diversity, and inclusion in our democracy.**You're sending a powerful message that every voice deserves to be heard, and every community deserves to be represented.**
Your support, no matter how big or small, will help us build a stronger, more inclusive future for Michigan and our nation. [**So I'm asking you: will you stand with me and be part of history?**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1562?t=3&akid=1248%2E62735%2ENctL0r) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately

| Dear Peter,
Republicans in Virginia have a unique opportunity. On June 18, they can elect one of the nation's leading constitutional experts and litigators to be the Republican standard bearer, my husband Jonathan Emord. He has defeated the best lawyers the DOJ has to offer and convinced even liberal judges to defend our constitutional rights against the Deep State. He is uniquely positioned to debate, defeat, and retire Tim Kaine.
My husband not only knows how the Deep State works, he knows how to defeat it. That's because he has done so in federal court over and over again.
He beat the FDA so many times that the pundits called him "the FDA Dragon Slayer."
We have one more election to get it right, to put our best foot forward, to elect the best and brightest, the only proven defender of our liberties in the race.
I shudder at the thought of what will become of our country, our freedoms, and our children's future if we squander this opportunity and allow the corrupt career politicians Biden and Kaine to be re-elected.
My dear friends and fellow patriots, won't you join me in voting for a man of incomparable wit, wisdom, courage, and insight, a modern-day founding father who not only fights but also wins repeatedly?
My husband is putting it all on the line for us. A vote for him is a vote for ourselves, for our Constitution, and for our future.
Join me in voting for Jonathan and donating to build the war chest against Kaine.
By donating $50, $100, $200, or $500, you are investing in freedom, in the fight to ensure that the sacred fire of liberty remains kindled and is never extinguished.
For the sake of all that has made America the greatest nation on earth, we must support and elect Jonathan Emord to the U.S. Senate.
For freedom's sake,
Sheryl Emord

Dear Pro-Life Defender,

It's Sarah Huckabee Sanders. I'm a lifelong pro-life advocate, a mom of three beautiful children, and I am honored to serve as the Governor of Arkansas where I am fighting back against the current administration's pro-abortion extremism.

**The other side is counting on you to stand on the sidelines and sit back as they destroy ALL our pro-life progress, letting countless babies and mothers suffer from abortion.**

Throughout my career, I've been committed to the pro-life cause and I'm proud to say there's no better team fighting the good fight for life than SBA Pro-Life America.

I'm reaching out to you today with an urgent request--our fight to serve women and save babies from abortion in our nation is at a critical stage. Current administration policies advance access to abortion drugs, and want nothing more than to allow abortion-on-demand to be a right in our own Constitution!

This is why I'm partnering with SBA Pro-Life America to build and mobilize grassroots support for life-saving legislation that will protect innocent children from suffering violent deaths in the womb because of the deadly policies being forced on the American people by abortion extremists.

Right now, as pro-life Americans, we share a profound obligation: a call to stand for those who cannot stand for themselves. We find ourselves in a crucial moment in our nation's history and your urgent support TODAY is necessary to ensure our future is pro-life!

With your partnership, we can continue propelling the mission of SBA Pro-Life America forward, serving women and saving babies. We urgently need to raise funds to counteract the Biden administration's detrimental policies and to endorse life-affirming legislation.

Your gift today will create a significant impact in the fight. By supporting SBA Pro-Life America, you're strengthening our movement in critical ways:

● Expanding our nationwide grassroots movement to endorse and protect laws that serve women and save babies.
● Deploying powerful advertising campaigns to challenge and expose the extreme abortion agendas of organizations like Planned Parenthood.
● Igniting an unprecedented wave of pro-life advocacy, ensuring that voters are educated and motivated to support life-affirming politicians and policies in this critical election season.

**To fuel all this critical work, would you step forward and give -- $35, $50, or even $100--right now to help SBA Pro-Life America on its life-saving mission?

**You can make your gift at the link below:

[https://secure.sbaprolife.org/before-its-too-late](http://trk.secureandprosper.)

The clock is ticking--I'm looking to make big progress in their fundraising need over the next five days.

Together, we can make a big difference in this fight for life. Give generously today to help save innocent lives and stand with us for a pro-life future.

God bless you,

Sarah Huckabee Sanders
Governor of Arkansas

Let’s make one thing clear: Marjorie Taylor Greene is 100% to blame for starting the chaos and dysfunction during our Oversight hearing. She needs to apologize and be removed from her committees. I'm the only Democrat who sits on the same three committees as Marjorie Taylor Greene and have seen her pattern of behavior time and time again. Not only does she have no business being in Congress, but she's a danger to the House. She has continuously caused chaos and disruption. She uses her voice to spread hatred, lies, and conspiracies. And she doesn’t even attempt to legislate to help the American people. Enough is enough. It’s time to end the circus and remove Marjorie Taylor Greene from the Oversight Committee. Thanks for standing by my side. Robert * Paid for by Robert Garcia for Congress Robert Garcia for Congress 65 Pine Ave #348 Long Beach, CA 90802 United States This email was sent to . Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to receive this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=58ddf1bc94-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

Vargas on Newsmax: Trump Prosecution is "Grasping at Straws" and Star Witnesses are "Serial Liars," Calls for the "Circus" to End (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/vargas-on-newsmax-trump-prosecution-is-grasping-at-straws-and-star-witnesses-are-serial-liars-calls-for-the-circus-to-end.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=58ddf1bc94-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/vargas-on-newsmax-trump-prosecution-is-grasping-at-straws-and-star-witnesses-are-serial-liars-calls-for-the-circus-to-end.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=58ddf1bc94-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

By Illinois Review

On Monday, Illinois Review Editor-in-Chief and Newsmax political commentator Mark Vargas appeared on the conservative news channel to discuss the Trump trial – calling it a “circus” as the prosecution’s case falls apart after their star witnesses lose all credibility on the stand during President Donald Trump’s historic criminal trial in New York City.

Appearing on Monday during a breaking news segment on Newsmax, Vargas noted the absurdity of the case, saying,

“I think there’s no question that the prosecution is really grasping at straws and it doesn’t take a legal scholar to see what’s happening here – and there’s a problem when your two star witnesses – your two key witnesses – both Stormy Daniels and Michael Cohen are proven liars.”
https://x.com/MarkAVargas/status/1792702396721991748?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=58ddf1bc94-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Vargas also pointed out that both star witnesses personally “profited” off President Trump – the defendant in this case, by promoting “merchandise saying ‘let’s put the 45th President of the United States Donald Trump – let’s put him behind bars – let’s put him in jail’.”

The judge overseeing the trial – Judge Juan Merchan – has yet to address glaring “conflicts of interest” as Vargas pointed out – bringing into serious question the judge’s inability to conceal his political bias where the defendant is a former U.S. president and the presumptive Republican nominee for president in the 2024 presidential election.

“This has been nothing but a circus and the fact that this judge who made a very small donation – but it’s a donation nonetheless to Joe Biden’s presidential campaign in 2020 is real problematic – and it does represent a conflict of interest – his daughter being a Democratic political operative. And so when you put all of these things together, the prosecution is in real trouble and I think the jury is going to be smart enough to see that they are also in trouble with all of these blatant conflicts of interest.”

Vargas then called the trial a “circus that should no longer continue.”

The IR Editor-in-Chief and political commentator has appeared regularly on Newsmax during the trial offering insights and commentary.

Vargas on Newsmax: Trump Prosecution is "Grasping at Straws" and Star Witnesses are "Serial Liars," Calls for the "Circus" to End () By Illinois Review On Monday, Illinois Review Editor-in-Chief and Newsmax political commentator Mark Vargas appeared on the conservative news channel to discuss the Trump trial – calling it a “circus” as the prosecution’s case falls apart after their star witnesses lose all credibility on the stand during President Donald Trump’s historic criminal trial in New York City. Appearing on Monday during a breaking news segment on Newsmax, Vargas noted the absurdity of the case, saying, “I think there’s no question that the prosecution is really grasping at straws and it doesn’t take a legal scholar to see what’s happening here – and there’s a problem when your two star witnesses – your two key witnesses – both Stormy Daniels and Michael Cohen are proven liars.” Vargas also pointed out that both star witnesses personally “profited” off President Trump – the defendant in this case, by promoting “merchandise saying ‘let’s put the 45th President of the United States Donald Trump – let’s put him behind bars – let’s put him in jail’.” The judge overseeing the trial – Judge Juan Merchan – has yet to address glaring “conflicts of interest” as Vargas pointed out – bringing into serious question the judge’s inability to conceal his political bias where the defendant is a former U.S. president and the presumptive Republican nominee for president in the 2024 presidential election. “This has been nothing but a circus and the fact that this judge who made a very small donation – but it’s a donation nonetheless to Joe Biden’s presidential campaign in 2020 is real problematic – and it does represent a conflict of interest – his daughter being a Democratic political operative. And so when you put all of these things together, the prosecution is in real trouble and I think the jury is going to be smart enough to see that they are also in trouble with all of these blatant conflicts of interest.” Vargas then called the trial a “circus that should no longer continue.” The IR Editor-in-Chief and political commentator has appeared regularly on Newsmax during the trial offering insights and commentary. CONTACT: Houston Keene

ICYMI: Rep. Hageman Endorses Lt. Gov. Nancy Dahlstrom for Congress

ANCHORAGE, AK - In case you missed it, Congresswoman Harriet Hageman
(R-Wyo.) endorsed Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom in her run for Congress
late last week. Rep. Hageman's endorsement comes on the heels of other
prominent GOP female leaders' support, including House Republican
Conference Chairwoman Elise Stefanik and her Elevate PAC. Dahlstrom
also has the backing of Governor Mike Dunleavy as well as Republican
leaders at the highest echelons of government, including House Speaker
Mike Johnson, House Majority Leader Steve Scalise, and House Majority
Whip Tom Emmer.

In her endorsement, Rep. Hageman said:

"Of all places, Alaska must be represented by solid conservatives and
so I strongly support Nancy Dahlstrom for Congress," Rep. Hageman said
on X
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=68101&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=60313> . "As Lt. Gov., she has fought to protect
Alaska from Washington, DC, and in Congress she will fight to unleash
Alaska's limitless energy potential."

In response, Lt. Gov. Dahlstrom stated, "I am honored to receive Rep.
Hageman's endorsement in my run for Congress. Now more than ever, we
need real conservative, tough leadership in Congress, especially for
states like ours with only one representative. Rep. Hageman is a
bonafide conservative leader who is blazing the trail for women across
Wyoming and America. I look forward to serving with her in Washington."

You can read Rep. Hageman's endorsement of Lt. Governor Dahlstrom here
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=68101&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=60313> .

The next Governor is going to need to take tough stances and make hard decisions for Washington families. I voted against the regressive, poorly thought out long-term care payroll tax that is raising costs for families. body:
Even though we can’t match our opponents dollar-for-dollar, we CAN out-organize them. | | | Peter, this is an unusual request, but an absolutely crucial one. **And it will seriously boost our chances of re-electing Jamaal Bowman this year.** Let me explain: One of our core philosophies has always been that, even though we can’t match our opponents dollar-for-dollar, we CAN out-organize them. At the doorstep, on the phone, or over the internet, talking to voters about the very real, very serious issues affecting their day-to-day will always be more effective than whatever propaganda the right-wing PR firms churn out. Our biggest issue is scaling. Each organizer can only have so many conversations in a day. And with finite resources, we can only hire so many of them. Progressive campaigns, often with razor-thin budgets, face the same obstacle. **That’s why we are officially hiring up to FOUR field organizers in NY-16 — Jamaal Bowman’s district — to embed themselves with his campaign and talk to voters directly.** The organizers will be focused on the highest priority areas in the district. Not only will they be talking to voters face to face, they’ll also commit a lot of energy toward training and mobilizing volunteers. These are VITAL roles — and we believe they can help tip the scales. So first and foremost, [if you are in Jamaal Bowman’s district and have field campaign experience, I strongly encourage you to check out the job listing and apply here.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.o1U7tAOlmzfzv5xjBjF-e4VDPMF6QFy75zulQo_Hg6hDkW-8f1sUeWoBvqQmJNDOw8YYmJfO236PgSV1__QjAdXhQTd7a-BJcaKU6pfKzw3EZYhxGOp50mezpocDY1vXOm3ANuUS9TyvyPAkIBxeuAs-oFRkzdfAu8rm7FbfGtxqjPoGG4X-8n4mFLcMRS--TERHBsIoGoqce_ck3XH_eQP3tIa6ir0HEQVdQ1BptxZKLhowIfPz5zXBdyd3tdBuHIsciO8wYeJoqiFeYbb-lptyxFTbEN_j8ur5jQYeyRCZx6AQfTEKOkJblaSrePEFdE2JcgnXR5tsXIAs8WuPmcV4Xbf2duokAD4T8TOpBU04HebjDKxckrTHcVeZ9-usa9qG1hRak53isJlGuVbvHLouU2RzAzbz7Fn526vz8to/46j/m5VSGs3JRMWYy3Cdj_WlVQ/h0/h001.-1C9QiKq63Q3YoKSAC-9lXrvJn-7Sn7iW5c-wuje-qc) The new staff will be reporting to me (Hi!!!), and even though we’ve already filled some positions, we want to hire more ASAP. clean_body: Even though we can’t match our opponents dollar-for-dollar, we CAN out-organize them. | | | Peter, this is an unusual request, but an absolutely crucial one. And it will seriously boost our chances of re-electing Jamaal Bowman this year. Let me explain: One of our core philosophies has always been that, even though we can’t match our opponents dollar-for-dollar, we CAN out-organize them. At the doorstep, on the phone, or over the internet, talking to voters about the very real, very serious issues affecting their day-to-day will always be more effective than whatever propaganda the right-wing PR firms churn out. Our biggest issue is scaling. Each organizer can only have so many conversations in a day. And with finite resources, we can only hire so many of them. Progressive campaigns, often with razor-thin budgets, face the same obstacle. That’s why we are officially hiring up to FOUR field organizers in NY-16 — Jamaal Bowman’s district — to embed themselves with his campaign and talk to voters directly. The organizers will be focused on the highest priority areas in the district. Not only will they be talking to voters face to face, they’ll also commit a lot of energy toward training and mobilizing volunteers. These are VITAL roles — and we believe they can help tip the scales. So first and foremost, The new staff will be reporting to me (Hi!!!), and even though we’ve already filled some positions, we want to hire more ASAP. So please share the link with your friends if they might be interested. My second request is for everyone else: So many of you are already doing SO SO MUCH for WFP and our broader movement. And I truly cannot overstate how grateful we are. All that support is what allows us to continue this kind of work, and support all these amazing elected officials when the GOP megadonors come after them. Thanks again, Isabel Alter Federal Affairs Team Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. body:
We are in a statistical dead-heat against one of the leading Republicans, Mike Rogers — with a ton of Michigan swing voters still undecided. |
#
Friend, this is Elissa Slotkin. We just got new polling on the race for U.S. Senate here in Michigan, and I wanted to make sure you saw it. Bottom line: We are in a statistical dead-heat against one of the leading Republicans, Mike Rogers — with a ton of Michigan swing voters still undecided. Elissa Slotkin: 39.8%
Mike Rogers: 36.8%
Undecided: 23.3% Polling is a notoriously fickle science, especially since it’s still early, but this data underscores a fundamental truth: Michigan is a swing state, and swing states have a tendency to...swing. Despite Democrats’ success in recent years, we know it can flip red under the right conditions. So in light of this new poll, I want to ask if you’ll consider making a $3 contribution to my campaign. $3, because we are in a statistical tie against a Trump-endorsed candidate. $3, because Democrats only have a 51-seat majority in the U.S. Senate, and with Joe Manchin’s retirement and a likely flip in West Virginia, we need to hold onto this seat for Democrats to retain control of the body. $3, because our race is the top of the ticket in Michigan — which means what happens will likely have an impact on the presidential race here as well. $3, because more than 1 in 5 voters are undecided in our race, and we need to be able to talk to those voters in all 11 of Michigan’s media markets. clean_body: We are in a statistical dead-heat against one of the leading Republicans, Mike Rogers — with a ton of Michigan swing voters still undecided. | Friend, this is Elissa Slotkin. We just got new polling on the race for U.S. Senate here in Michigan, and I wanted to make sure you saw it. Bottom line: We are in a statistical dead-heat against one of the leading Republicans, Mike Rogers — with a ton of Michigan swing voters still undecided. Elissa Slotkin: 39.8% Mike Rogers: 36.8% Undecided: 23.3% Polling is a notoriously fickle science, especially since it’s still early, but this data underscores a fundamental truth: Michigan is a swing state, and swing states have a tendency to...swing. Despite Democrats’ success in recent years, we know it can flip red under the right conditions. So in light of this new poll, I want to ask if you’ll consider making a $3 contribution to my campaign. $3, because we are in a statistical tie against a Trump-endorsed candidate. $3, because Democrats only have a 51-seat majority in the U.S. Senate, and with Joe Manchin’s retirement and a likely flip in West Virginia, we need to hold onto this seat for Democrats to retain control of the body. $3, because our race is the top of the ticket in Michigan — which means what happens will likely have an impact on the presidential race here as well. $3, because more than 1 in 5 voters are undecided in our race, and we need to be able to talk to those voters in all 11 of Michigan’s media markets. ### What are we doing for future generations???
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/redirect/9ab26f0b-d8b4-4119-a8b1-ebc59c198917?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Dear Friend,

As we stand at the crossroads of our nation's history, it's clear that the choices we make today will shape the future for generations to come. I am dedicated to fighting for the values and principles that we believe are essential for securing a prosperous and free future for our nation.

I am proud to be a voice for conservatism, advocating for policies and ideas that prioritize individual liberty, fiscal responsibility, and traditional values. Our mission is not just about winning elections or scoring political points; it's about safeguarding the foundations of our republic and preserving the American Dream for future generations!

To stay informed and engaged in the battle for our nation's future, I invite you to subscribe to our conservative channels. By subscribing, you'll gain access to:

1\. Thought-provoking articles and analyses that offer conservative perspectives on current events and issues facing our nation.
2\. Exclusive interviews and discussions with prominent conservative leaders and thinkers.
3\. Actionable insights and opportunities to get involved in grassroots efforts to promote conservative values in your community and beyond.

Together, we can make a difference. By subscribing to our conservative channels, you'll be joining a community of like-minded individuals who are committed to fighting for the future of our nation.

To subscribe, simply click on link to your platform of choice!!

Thank you for subscribing, and thank you for standing with us in the fight for our nation's future.

Best regards,

Dan Carr

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Untitled%20design.png]
Trump shared a video suggesting his victory would bring a "unified Reich." It was quickly taken down. Elections in America do not have to invoke this type of rhetoric.
I'm in this race to fight for our families, freedoms, and future.
Join our fight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
CONTRIBUTE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friends,
No one should be winning votes by suggesting we should deport 15 million immigrants, crash our workforce, destroy families, and create food shortages. We must reject threats to Medicare or Social Security, and no one's campaign strategy should be to promise windfall tax cuts to billionaires in exchange for campaign contributions.
Furthermore, criminalizing reproductive healthcare isn't the way to win over the constituency, and we cannot ignore the plight of the youth who are losing hope to buy a home, save for retirement, pay for their education, or put food on the table.
My Trump-republican opponent is on board with all of this junk. So, Rep. Bergman, we have to ask - is this the "reich" you really want to be part of?
As I see it, Northern Michigan and the UP has different plans. We need family-sustaining jobs, better wages, universal healthcare, women's rights, and clean drinking water and air.
Our citizens want to be able to afford rent, buy groceries, and pay their bills.
We desire connectivity—broadband, better infrastructure, schools, childcare, and reliable, sustainable energy.
I've had it with division and chaos because, clearly, we have way too much work to do.
Thank you for your support in this fight to maintain a positive campaign focused on the issues that hardworking people care about.
-Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

name: Jason Kander
subject: We’ll see you at the polls
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pereles for Missouri, Rhonda West, Treasurer
body:
https://www.perelesformissouri.com/ [https://www.perelesformissouri.com/]
Peter,
This is Jason Kander, and I want to talk with you about a very important opportunity we have right now to stand up for all of us here in Missouri.
Having served as Missouri’s Secretary of State from 2013 until 2017, and before that as a State Representative, I know what it takes to serve effectively in government. As an Army Intelligence Officer in Afghanistan, I have met and worked with people from all walks of life. But most importantly, I know what it takes to confront hard issues, and fight together for a better future for everyone.
That is the kind of commitment and dedication that makes Missourians proud. And that is what is so great about my friend Joe Pereles, who is running to flip a State Senate seat in St. Louis County red to blue : Joe is the kind of guy who will make us proud. A person with integrity, and grit. Someone with valuable experience serving others as a 37 year volunteer with the Red Cross, or delivering meals for a local food pantry.
Joe didn’t do any of that to advance a political career. He has served others his entire life because it was the right thing to do.
And now, because he saw the need, Joe has stepped up to run for State Senate. He is just the person we need in Jefferson City. And we have a chance to help elect Joe Pereles to the Missouri State Senate and change this state for the better.
In 2017, at the end of my term as Secretary of State, I delivered one final speech before the General Assembly. I still remember that speech—standing on the dais before a captive audience of folks who had made no secret of their disagreement with me and my values, I called for protecting Missourians’ right to vote and preserving our democracy, making an appeal to our better angels:
“Even though you have the power to take away the right to vote from the citizens of Missouri, you shouldn’t...but if you choose to [do so], well then: I guess we will see you in court.”
The current supermajority in Jefferson City is working harder than ever to do exactly what I warned about: take away the voice of the people, stripping us of our ability to be heard and to weigh in on many important policies that directly affect our lives.
And now, by electing Joe and flipping this seat, we will be on our way to end the supermajority in the State Senate, protecting our voting rights and getting things done in ways that will make all of us proud.
Folks, we have an incredible opportunity to end the chaos and stop the senseless attacks on democracy and majority rule. But this time, instead of saying “we’ll see you in court,” we say: “ we’ll see you at the polls.”
This is a crucial time. I hope you will send Joe some support so that we can win this crucial State Senate seat. Please join me in supporting Joe Pereles : [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=kander]

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: I didn’t know this was still possible.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

I read a story today about public education in Texas that left me hopeful.
Honestly, I didn’t know that was still possible.

This one involved a conservative school board trustee in Granbury, written
by Jeremy Schwartz in the Texas Tribune (link:
[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63513?t=1001&akid=239605%2E444211%2E-915lE ]texastribune.org/2024/05/15/texas-granbury-isd-school-board-courtney-gore/).

The trustee at the center of this story, Courtney Gore, won her election
promising voters that she would eradicate inappropriate sexual and racial
themes from school curriculum and school libraries. You’ve probably seen
these kinds of attacks on public schools from right-wing extremists,
claiming that porn can be found in the library, kids are being groomed by
their teachers, and students are being indoctrinated in Marxism and
critical race theory.

Have you seen this stuff in your kids’ schools?

We haven't. Probably because this kind of stuff isn’t in our schools.
These spurious allegations are not really about porn, LGBTQ kids or
communism. Instead they’re part of a larger effort to undermine faith in
our public schools – one of the most cherished institutions in Texas – so
that they can be more easily drained of resources in the service of Gov.
Abbott’s voucher scheme. The idea: tear down public schools so that voters
are less resistant to the idea of public school funds going to private
schools.

Though Gore, the Granbury ISD trustee, ran on this very platform, once she
was elected and began to review school curriculum, policies and practices
she found that the feared sexualization of kids was not happening. Nor
were they being taught critical race theory. Gore concluded that she had
been duped into supporting a slew of false accusations as a candidate.
Much to her credit, she renounced the lies once she was in office and
learned the truth. And while her stand has caused her a lot of personal
grief with her former backers, she has also given hope to many in her
district, perhaps giving others the courage to take on and defeat a number
of MAGA candidates who recently attempted to take a majority on the school
board.

This story renews my faith that, beyond all the differences between us as
Texans – including our partisan differences – we still by and large
believe in the same core values, including protecting and improving public
schools. Gore is facing intense pressure from MAGA extremists (one brought
a gun to a school board meeting and said “we have profile sheets” on all
the trustees; “We know what you do,” he told them. “We know where you
live.”), but she has the courage of her convictions to do the right thing
for the children, taxpayers and educators that she represents on the
school board.

We need more people doing the right thing for the right reasons; restoring
our faith in democracy and public leadership.

I’m confident that when we support pro-public education candidates, when
we register and turn out new voters who are armed with the truth about
these attacks on public schools, and when we do it everywhere – including
in conservative and rural counties across Texas – we will get a better
leaders and a better public education system for our state.

That’s why Powered by People volunteers put in the work to reach, register
and turn out voters in every county in Texas.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240521.WHsvzv&refcode=ema20240521-239605&t=1002&akid=239605%2E444211%2E-915lE ]Your contribution ensures we have the resources to stay in the field,
bring on new voters, and help good people run for and stay in office.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240521.WHsvzv&refcode=ema20240521-239605&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=239605%2E444211%2E-915lE ]DONATE $3

Thank you for your help,

Beto

| Did you see this previous message from Bill? In case you missed it, check it out now: I wanted to share a touching story that recently unfolded, showcasing the incredible kindness and generosity that epitomizes the spirit of New Jersey. Last week, we received a call from Penny, a 71-year-old woman facing a challenging situation with her broken HVAC system. As she tearfully explained her predicament during a discussion about affordability in our state, something remarkable happened. Ryan, a service manager at First Choice Plumbing and Heating, listened to Penny's story and immediately offered a solution: a free HVAC system and installation. This act of kindness not only provided Penny with much-needed relief but also sparked a new friendship that warmed all our hearts.
When my wife Jodi and I visited Penny's home to witness the installation, we were deeply moved by the generosity extended by Ryan and his team. Not only did they donate the system and labor, but they also paid Penny's HOA fees for the entire year—an extraordinary gesture of compassion and solidarity. This moment reminded me once again why New Jersey is such a special place. When it comes to rallying around those in need, New Jerseyans stand out as the epitome of kindness and generosity. This is precisely what the Common Sense Club holds near and dear to its heart—making New Jersey a better place for all New Jerseyans. It's about extending a helping hand, fostering connections, and embodying the values of compassion and community. I invite you to watch the video of our meeting with Penny for the first time, and I hope it inspires you as much as it has inspired me. With gratitude, Bill

Fellow patriot – It’s time to take back the Senate from Chuck Schumer’s grip, and we’re gonna do it with Bernie Moreno in Ohio. He’s a Republican firecracker with a heart of gold and a passion for this country like you wouldn’t believe.

We’re treating climate change like what it is — an emergency.

The science on climate change is as clear: unless we act boldly, and with speed, we are going to see more drought, more wildfire, more severe weather, more disease, more famine, more climate migration, and more human suffering.
Out of all the issues in this election for the White House, Senate, House and more — the issue of climate change must be near the top.
Trump? He thinks climate change is a hoax and is literally asking Big Oil for $1 billion for his campaign in exchange for rolling back the environmental progress of the Biden Administration.
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/3389?t=1&akid=2021%2E4767699%2EEecld0)
In California we have made record investments to protect our communities against climate change: strengthening clean air laws, the single largest investment in wildfire preparedness in our state’s history, requiring cars sold be zero-emission vehicles by 2035, and much more.
We’re treating climate change like what it is — an emergency.
But if we lose this election on a national level, there may be no turning back from that.
Gavin Newsom

body:
I've served my country, I serve my wife and my three girls, and now I'm serving you.

|
---
[](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=8f43fd3762fb410bbdd97e3d6b97f486&_e=W50XE7gotZbsBMC-vvFMqZBZUEDKUGfKDBEyUWp6TEHC0V94SP6Zhoj_37B4tZNMgPcvwb91yMOTMPr-jHDiSxSicKbEsXPh0QNo5-qmwfgfCvTlQ0HyX8FLz8K-j_39ATver62x_PAZu9tnOLUfl1Q-tgXOkid7vFxt5DMDCVwAC46-T1d1kkBvwDJkMdF7ccosEuvm3siDe7txXlsVh4ISmE7YAir2A3_6hKnkXSjWQ-XDFt-S3kNESeFXP68upMq8oOL9er-YzD7ybC8RD1LZjG7inrYatwNsIwurWNxPiaLh5Xj_0q3VITMvKCTl)
Hello, neighbor.

I was scrolling through my contacts and stopped at your name - have we met?

If you don't remember me, my name is Jim Banks, and I'm an Afghanistan veteran from Indiana now serving in Congress.

**I 've served my country, I serve my wife and my three girls, and now I'm serving you.**

If you couldn't tell, I've tried to dedicate my life to service.

**Now, I am also running to serve in the Senate in a crucial race in Indiana. The outcome of this election will determine if we can take back the Senate.**

Folks like Joe Biden are working their hardest to wipe out guys like me with their million-dollar donors and massive warchests.

[**That 's why I'm humbly reaching out to you today.**](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=8f43fd3762fb410bbdd97e3d6b97f486&_e=W50XE7gotZbsBMC-vvFMqZBZUEDKUGfKDBEyUWp6TEHC0V94SP6Zhoj_37B4tZNMgPcvwb91yMOTMPr-jHDiSxSicKbEsXPh0QNo5-qmwfgfCvTlQ0HyX8FLz8K-j_39ATver62x_PAZu9tnOLUfl6SIVJOjBv3fAe0qLxQvqIHb2VCtA-oMMftqKGow0GJg4jsuTKmamZ2f5r2wVLvw0waOu-M63_uQNzjoGoXpX9GAUaobDDmOEUggrQlLOtGXgXvZncLQu1Zf7LkrCRKjvlo72L98Hl-LoFKt9s27eTUW0rnIedZk2EhDYcCAl-5J)

name: Angela Alsobrooks
subject: I’m the Democratic nominee in Maryland!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
it’s official: Last week, I won the Maryland U.S. Senate Democratic primary and will be taking on Republican Larry Hogan in November.

Make no mistake, Larry Hogan won’t be easy to beat. He was handpicked by Mitch McConnell and his MAGA allies have already started pouring in millions of dollars to defeat me.

The GOP’s plan to take back the Senate majority hinges on Maryland. That’s why I need your help stopping them starting right now.

My team has a General Election Founding Donor Goal that we must hit within the next week to have the resources to start the general on the right foot. Will you chip in a split grassroots donation right now between my campaign and Seth Moulton to become a General Election Founding Donor?

Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/seth-moulton-3]As Prince George’s County Executive and a former state’s attorney, I’ve spent my career fighting on behalf of Maryland families. In the Senate, I’ll be a strong voice in support of abortion rights, equality, education, and economic opportunity.

But, my Republican opponent Larry Hogan? He’s working against our Maryland values.

As Governor, he vetoed a $15 minimum wage, common sense gun legislation, and access to increased reproductive and abortion care in Maryland.

On the campaign trail, he has continually flip-flopped on the issues because he’s afraid to stand up to his party. He’s even called access to reproductive care an “emotional issue for women”.

The simple truth is this: Mitch McConnell is banking on flipping this seat and using Hogan’s vote to pass a national abortion ban, destroy Social Security and Medicare, and give tax breaks to MAGA big money donors.

I look forward to making sure every Maryland voter knows just how dangerous Larry Hogan would be in the U.S. Senate. But, we need resources immediately to start putting his feet to the fire.

We just have 6 months to win this race, so we need your help ASAP. Will you split a donation of $25 between Seth Moulton and my campaign to become a General Election Founding Donor and defeat Republican Larry Hogan in November?

Thanks for your support,
Angela Alsobrooks

name: Carmen Goers
subject: Protect Our Farmers and Farmland in Washington’s 8th
body:
Join the Team

| | | | | | | |
---
| | | |
---
| | | **Protect Our Farmers and Farmland in Washington’s 8th**
---

Dear Peter,
A recent [article from The Seattle Times](https://vgq.soundestlink.com/ce/c/652845d9aa222127cf458b43/664b9029437780686252318d/664d0b8d41f974d6334d2b18?signature=f5d3d8bee416ade531e43238e696c9cd8d633a80c614aa55670336af50ba586e) highlights a pressing issue for Washington's 8th congressional district: the alarming loss of farms and food-producing land. As urban sprawl and development encroach on our agricultural heritage, we risk losing not only our local food supply but also a vital part of our community and economy.
Carmen Goers is committed to safeguarding our farmers and preserving our precious farmland. Her campaign focuses on supporting local farmers, fighting hostile state and federal agricultural policy, and protecting our rural landscapes from over-regulation.
---
| | | |

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He’s running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. Curtis’ company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island’s East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

Growing up, my dad was a Snohomish County PUD power line worker and long-time member of IBEW Local 77 — an affiliation he wore proudly. As one of eight siblings, his union job quite literally put a shirt on our backs and food on our table. rowing up, my dad was a Snohomish County PUD power line worker and long-time member of IBEW Local 77 - an affiliation he wore proudly. **As the Ranking Member of the House Transportation Committee, I will continue to fight for a robust nationwide infrastructure program that puts people to work building our roads, bridges, and highways.** I believe it is our party's mission to build a better country in which working people know that somebody has their back and they have a seat at the table. The Los Angeles Times ran a profile on Laura this week. It captures not just the legislative warrior that Laura is, but the real person we’ve come to know. [**You can check it out here!**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85382631/474573993/1849801664?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDdkN2QzNjItYjkxNy1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=oNhXsbH29i2AcSUVksWgXrRGCwjwkztYXKeya5AUTBc=&emci=7143a059-b917-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=d7d7d362-b917-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=8447100) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85382632/474573994/1849801664?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDdkN2QzNjItYjkxNy1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=oNhXsbH29i2AcSUVksWgXrRGCwjwkztYXKeya5AUTBc=&emci=7143a059-b917-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=d7d7d362-b917-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=8447100) Here are just a few of the many highlights: | **There are certain candidates** who have lived their lives like perfectly calibrated political arrows, arcing ever upward through all the right stops toward higher office. Not Laura Friedman. The Glendale Assembly member, who will probably soon take Rep. Adam B. Schiff’s prized congressional seat, spent her 20s with a $600 custom pool cue stick in the trunk of her car.
---
**Standing on the sun-dappled** members-only portico just off the Assembly floor on a Monday morning weeks after the March primary, Friedman said that when she first decided to run for public office in 2009, Glendale City Council had seemed like it would be the be-all, end-all of her political career. But Friedman — who served two terms on the council, as well as a yearlong stint as Glendale’s mayor — ran successfully for the Legislature in 2016 and held leadership roles chairing the Assembly’s transportation and natural resources committees.
---

Peter,
We often tell you about Leaders We Deserve, but today let us tell you about some leaders we **DON’T** deserve.
Our endorsed slate of bold, progressive young leaders are up against some GOP opponents who want to turn back the clock in some dangerous ways.

In Georgia, our candidate Ashwin Ramaswami is running against Republican State Sen. He was indicted, but the GOP refused to suspend him from public office.1
Also in Georgia, our candidate Bryce Berry is an Atlanta public school teacher who is running against State Rep. Mesha Mainor, who actually left the Democratic Party and **_became a Republican_ after voting to defund public education** in the state.2
Another one of our Leaders-endorsed candidates, Anna Thomas, is facing staunchly anti-choice Republican State Rep. Joe Emrick in Pennsylvania who not only sponsored legislation to **prohibit abortion coverage** under ACA health care plans, but has been a consistent opponent to reproductive freedom in the state.3
**This is only a small sample of the terrible Republicans our endorsed candidates are working to defeat in November.** These GOP politicians want to take us backward on every issue that matters to our generation: gun control, abortion rights, the climate crisis, and more.
It’s up to us to stop that from happening.

Dear Peter,
I am available any day of the week to debate.
President Biden and Former President Trump have agreed to 2 debates with one of the rules being no other candidates allowed. What are they afraid of?
The answer is obvious: Me - coming up strong in the polls.
I am the only presidential candidate in history who has polled ahead of both major party candidates in head-to-head races.
In fact, I am well ahead of President Biden and tied with Former President Trump among Independents. _That is 70 million Americans!_
The largest and most accurate polling firm in this election cycle, Zogby confirmed this in their recent poll of head-to-head matchups.
If President Biden won’t stand up and debate me, I will debate President Trump.
Donald Trump has said he’s not afraid to debate me as long as my poll numbers are decent. _They are now well past decent._ Let’s show the American public that at least 2 of the major candidates aren’t afraid to debate each other.
The American people deserve to see the top candidates debate.
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://www.kennedy24.com/debate-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=debates_5_21_24_nd1&n=6)
Help me get the message out – Debates allow the American public to make an informed decision. Sign our petition to demand a debate among the three major candidates, me, Former President Trump, and President Biden.
You deserve it.
The election is rapidly approaching and we need your support to continue to build on our surging poll numbers and, more importantly, to get our message out to every American so they can make an informed decision.
That’s what debates are for!
To make this happen, I need your help. [Please sign our petition today to support our call for open debates. Every signature counts and brings us closer to ensuring that all voices are heard on the debate stage.](https://www.kennedy24.com/debate-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=debates_5_21_24_nd1&n=7)

Thank you for your commitment to our cause and for believing in a different, better future.

| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10848489.5404.1.27bd556792b44aa0f7fb67bfcd094b36)

What are grounds for a **biblical divorce**? This question has been hotly debated for 2000 years in the Church. **Jesus** says grounds for a biblical divorce = "_except for sexual immorality_." What does that mean? Is _abuse_ grounds for a biblical divorce? I address this and more in the series we are going through at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10848489.5405.1.d8307c5df84aba6c5e81d063b7223fd4) over the[Gospel of Matthew](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10848489.5406.1.9bf7c1a32739cbcb388f93250323f830). I also address how to _prevent_ a marriage from ever reaching the place of grounds for a biblical divorce. Watch [Matthew Pt. 9 - SEX, MARRIAGE + DIVORCE](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10848489.5407.1.c0031815e3e614b2fa28abc73c4bbcc7) here: [https://youtube.com/live/QBndJugRbTo](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10848489.5408.1.b18ee17b056ce80c376e62172c340407) Thank you,

| Peter,

If there’s anything I know about Southern California, it’s that we are one of the most diverse and culturally rich communities in the country.

This month, we are not just celebrating, but truly honoring **Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander (AANHPI) Heritage** , a heritage that has deeply and positively impacted our community!

We have one of the largest and most vibrant AANHPI communities right here in California. Their contributions to our history, culture, and success can not be overstated.

As an associate member of the Congressional Asian-Pacific American Caucus (CAPAC), I pledge to thoughtfully represent and advocate for this community. _**While anti-Asian hate crimes and prejudice of all groups are on the rise, it has never been more important to stand strong and fight for justice.**_

In the face of adversity, let us not only celebrate the unique and inspiring strength, resilience, and unity of AANHPI Heritage this May but also commit to standing against the hate and prejudice these communities experience. Together, let’s champion inclusivity, understanding, and support for ALL.

Sincerely,

Linda Sánchez

body:
Extreme Republicans have used voter suppression tactics to silence the voices of millions. There is nothing more fundamental to defending our democracy than protecting our voting rights.

But, Peter, that hasn’t stopped extreme Republicans from using voter suppression tactics and silencing the voices of millions – _particularly in marginalized communities_ – to try and advance their own agenda.

Including shamelessly stalling the _John Lewis Voting Rights Act_ , a critical piece of legislation designed to protect and expand the right to vote for every American. _**But that’s not all, they’ve also...**_
* **Enacted stricter voter ID laws:** Implementing stringent ID requirements that disproportionately affect minorities, the elderly, and low-income voters.
* **Purged voter rolls:** Removing millions of voters from registration lists, often without proper notification, targeting communities of color and young voters.
* **Attempting to reduce early voting:** Cutting back on early voting days and hours, making it harder for people with inflexible schedules to vote.
* **Closing Polling Places:** Shutting down polling locations in predominantly minority and low-income neighborhoods, leading to longer lines and wait times.
* **Gerrymandering their way to victory:** Drawing district lines to dilute the voting power of specific communities, ensuring Republican majorities despite popular vote totals.

[**Peter, will you consider chipping in just $10, $5, or whatever you can to help me fight back by building a winning campaign ahead of November? >>**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85384837/474581510/1027042714?refcode=em24_240521_votefr_fndd_gq_act___WB_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240521_votefr_fndd_gq_act___WB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=5c66803f-c017-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWM2NjgwM2YtYzAxNy1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=15lbRfRdWn1mtKLhn5BXsklYIoZ84lIFHmLtxiKizcg=)

More than ever, we need leaders who will stand up against Republican efforts to undermine our democracy, and I am ready to be that leader. As your representative, I will work tirelessly to ensure that every eligible voter can exercise their right to make their voice heard at the polls freely and fairly.

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38868%2E3422442%2EqHHmzq)
Derek,
Katie Porter here. You may have noticed that the emails I’m sending you look a bit different than the ones I used to send, and now say “Truth to Power” at the top. That’s because while we didn’t advance out of California’s Senate primary in March, I’m not giving up our fight.
**My term serving CA-47 in the House runs through early January.** And until then, I’ll be doing everything I can to get some of our top priority pieces of legislation across the finish line. That includes continuing to push leadership to take up a bill effectively banning Members of Congress from trading stocks; holding Big Oil accountable; and using the Oversight Committee to get real answers for the American people.
I’m still focused on the future of our Congress, because I’ve seen how desperately we need to enact real change. On the campaign trail, I heard from so many Californians who distrust the government and are losing faith in our democracy’s ability to deliver for them. People see how beholden politicians are to their biggest donors and special interest groups. And, they don’t like the end result.
That’s why in 2020, as a freshman Member of Congress, I started Truth to Power. Truth to Power is a “Leadership PAC,” which is a campaign finance term that just means a political entity run by an elected official.
Since 2020, Truth to Power has been able to spend over $500,000 directly supporting Democrats and has raised more than $125,000 directly into candidates’ campaigns. We’ve endorsed and supported Democrats who reject corporate PAC money and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people.
Friday, May 31, will mark Truth to Power’s next end of month fundraising deadline.
Reporting a strong number will show pundits and politicians that we are ready to elect leaders who reject corporate PAC money and act in the best interest of the American people, not big corporations.
**[Ahead of 5/31, is there anything you can give to Truth to Power to send a powerful message to corporate interests, and help us support Democrats in must-win races across the country?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240521?refcode=em20240521-38868&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38868_3422442_qHHmzq&akid=38868%2E3422442%2EqHHmzq)**

Thanks for considering,
Katie Porter

That includes continuing to push leadership to take up a bill effectively banning Members of Congress from trading stocks; holding Big Oil accountable; and using the Oversight Committee to get real answers for the American people. I’m still focused on the future of our Congress, because I’ve seen how desperately we need to enact real change. On the campaign trail, I heard from so many Californians who distrust the government and are losing faith in our democracy’s ability to deliver for them. People see how beholden politicians are to their biggest donors and special interest groups. And, they don’t like the end result. That’s why in 2020, as a freshman Member of Congress, I started Truth to Power. Truth to Power is a “Leadership PAC,” which is a campaign finance term that just means a political entity run by an elected official. Since 2020, Truth to Power has been able to spend over $500,000 directly supporting Democrats and has raised more than $125,000 directly into candidates’ campaigns. We’ve endorsed and supported Democrats who reject corporate PAC money and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. Friday, May 31, will mark Truth to Power’s next end of month fundraising deadline. Reporting a strong number will show pundits and politicians that we are ready to elect leaders who reject corporate PAC money and act in the best interest of the American people, not big corporations. Thanks for considering, Katie Porter Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. Celebrate the 19th amendment, support today's fight for voting rights. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85386196/474586199/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MGI5NjBkNi1jNTE3LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JnMZEHPKnxiDtn4xuOxh9qjLTsq0fsL75M9aF9S3gnI=&emci=9cdf2975-9717-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=50b960d6-c517-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=15820338)

Peter,

On this day in 1920, the _19th Amendment_ was officially passed, adding to the fight that gave women in our nation the ability to vote in all elections. This landmark piece of legislation was made possible by women who didn't take no for an answer – women who stood on the frontlines and demanded equal participation in our democracy.

While the legislation wasn't perfect, it paved the way for progress in our country.

Today, that progress has stalled. Republicans are actively using their slim majority to erode voting rights wherever they can. And instead of defending voting rights, our highly conservative Supreme Court has stood in lockstep with Republicans – validating their efforts to restrict millions of Americans' access to the ballot box.

I was born and raised with my four siblings in North Carolina by my parents, Kaytee and Bud. They didn't come from much, but they pushed me towards an education and instilled a hard work ethic. With a passion for law and justice, I earned my JD at UNC Chapel Hill. I then went on to marry my wife of 25 years (and going), Jo; we raised our son, Jack, who's currently following in his dad's footsteps as he's working to attain his law degree.

As a lawyer, I'm very proud of my track record. I was a commercial litigator for nearly three decades, where I was voted 10 times to Business NC's "Legal Elite" and was selected 7 times by "Super Lawyers." I was tenacious as a litigator and handled complex cases. But, I finally felt that it was time to help a broader scope of North Carolinians and decided to run for Congress.

In Congress, I've been one of the toughest and most outspoken conservatives, challenging the radical left and holding my fellow Republicans accountable. As a member of the judiciary committee and the subcommittee on the weaponization of the federal government, I fought the Biden administration's dangerous policies and exposed the federal government's abuses against the Trump presidency.

Now, I'm running for Attorney General to defend the rule of law and protect North Carolina. I believe Democrats like Roy Cooper and Josh Stein have abused the state's top law enforcement office by turning it into a stepping stone for higher office and a platform to spread liberal propaganda. I'm putting my foot down, demanding respect for the office of Attorney General, and bringing Law and Order back to our great state.

This past weekend I had the distinct honor of serving as the keynote speaker at the American Pediatric Surgical Association annual meeting in Phoenix, Arizona. **_[So, what does that have to do with electing Kids First candidates to office? I’ll tell you...but first chip in $10 or any amount here if you agree: It’s time for everyone who cares about kids to get off the sidelines.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvGtKFwsLSzeDpaj11bS3Rb0ZZzBNKW7fcDBzWYIpzwE2v3OackmtohJ-J8pgqsDmV2AhRZf-malN4Kb_xAYZMa3_YeimOczeS-UtPaSpzKikwkyEGw7rI3lYyDuA23vStYWdSiOd2EC-i3wODb11fYW-r-nCAW5xx2So3GVfBRVf9nd2nKjw8CoNeZY3TksXmXxUv9Lu9qwuu77FNZMuYWdVYwGXAi9iZjthWaJEZbV7k1fcKiIysmDbr_Bw1pGsfFe15blUJvfeBiyhXsSu9a2crvFYqeJgJo3Gnp2YMjQy2Cq2rexYts9JlGbJVmrUmlaiDEHeWPGuD3FqDQ7rqExd14jntKsRNDyz1pO4GL2rIJhpdBKT0e1ZesQI2spxB1IAdj7yA0FyX2hNR3mmoD509hDdUp34EVvySN6qamXA/46j/kqb1GNlfTbOqHXsIJexpUA/h1/h001.hTfRU86I-m-LWSMjjGoohQOHt8bW5v-W74Yo1c8CuGs)_**

As I stood in front of 500+ surgeons, I told my story of getting off the sidelines after the 2016 election and after the Parkland shooting. The story of finding my voice and pushing myself so far outside of my comfort zone that I don't even remember what my comfort zone feels like.

**_All for one reason, or rather, for 73 million reasons — to build the brightest possible future for every single child in this country._**

I first explained I was there to talk about kids and politics. **_Yes, POLITICS_** — a word that is so often avoided in academic spaces for fear of being seen as partisan, biased, or unprofessional. But it is exactly BECAUSE we, as medical professionals, have avoided wading into politics, that our kids are left behind time and time again.

I made it clear I wasn't there to talk about firearm injury epidemiology because they don't need to hear that from me — **_they are on the frontlines; their scrubs are soaked in the blood of America's children._**

And if you think that sounds dramatic, I would push back and ask, is it actually possible to OVER-dramatize the death of any child in this country? I don't think so...

**_So what do we do?_**

In preparing this talk, I reviewed 2023 lobbying dollars spent by organizations that focus on kids and compared that to dollars spent by the AARP, an organization focused on Americans aged 50 and up. The numbers are genuinely shocking. In 2023 the AARP spent $16.5 million on lobbying and the American Academy of Pediatrics spent just $980,000.

**_This disinvestment and de-prioritization of America's children must end today — that’s where YOU and Their Future PAC comes in...._

_[We’re working to elect Kids First candidates this November so we can finally put the health and wellbeing of children at the forefront of our political decisions.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvGtKFwsLSzeDpaj11bS3Rb0ZZzBNKW7fcDBzWYIpzwE2v3OackmtohJ-J8pgqsDmV2AhRZf-malN4Kb_xAYZMa3_YeimOczeS-UtPaSpzKikwkyEGw7rI3lYyDuA23vSvYqi99s2uCWQTYyfcbnFGf6khqz6qHajPTg8y6ai3ndag5O2cTpKbaiQhFWo3rlooXLCoO2-S7YRlbglX4gW-heAkKaKAqCdaQD1yZyyOLZ14Ex019mRJOwPKNMqXOtMwRgRgtnDQxcUKGkhcpwqBgKuEAK2mTj2I23OEHJjdPdsIeeOieXmgkWSJtlffzdUGjoOyB3NnQpH1kuNU2Ku_O7a2LdWdtAQMnRGJQoFDBMZfzo_xgjJUdi0sezDsmMZgDA1VtjoHD1rr68yTB8BBA9HlVRZvVHhZKbDzLwU9Aqw/46j/kqb1GNlfTbOqHXsIJexpUA/h2/h001.7u7SjHR1-bL2Wap7Tb-ypAc8OY3dO8xKJCcBOTIwo4E)_**

Until the kids are alright.

— Dr. Annie Andrews

When will enough be enough for them? The sad answer: There is no “enough” for them. Their lust for money is insatiable and threatens life as we know it. But our movement is strong. We’ve already brought the fight to their backyard by helping propel Jane PAC-endorsed candidates like Reps. Greg Casar and Jasmine Crockett to victory in Texas in 2022. And just today, we announced the endorsement of Molly Cook , who’s running for TX State Senate! But this isn’t just about Texas — the climate crisis will be at our doorsteps no matter where we live, which is why we are endorsing candidates in key down-ballot races across the country who will take definitive action on climate. It can be daunting to take on billionaires, but here’s the truth: There are so many more of us than there are of them. Let’s show them what people power looks like. Donald Trump can be bought; the sustainable future we are building together cannot. Our movement cannot. = Thank you and solidarity, The Jane PAC Team | = | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. It saddens me to see that our education system has been taken over by radicals who push insane political ideologies like CRT, DEI, transgenderism and more on our poor children.

To me, it's common sense that school curriculum needs to be focused on the priority of teaching kids basic subjects such as reading, math, and civics.

How did that basic knowledge seem to get conveniently lost over the years?

You and I know that when it comes to a child's education and health, as well as their moral and religious upbringing, parents are primarily responsible.

That's why I believe parents have the right to steer their children's education, especially when it comes to sensitive subjects and that schools should resist the incorporation of non-academic subjects that fall within the family's purview.
